jobs.title: Global OT Application Developer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Developer
builds, maintains, tests and stabilises application components and use cases for industrial environments. The role converts approved requirements, designs and standards into reliable software, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards that can be reused across applications and sites.

The Application Developer works closely with Application Engineers throughout implementation, integration, testing and stabilisation, must understand the operational and technical context in which the solution will run, and remains involved in resolving defects and technical issues. It is not an isolated coding position.

Assigned scope:

Configuration and development of use cases within Global OT applications.
Development and maintenance of standard interfaces between Global OT applications.
Implementation of improvements to ensure correct performance of Global OT applications and interfaces.
Writing and maintaining technical documentation, release notes and other documentation required for proper software governance.

Primary emphasis:

Features that are stable, maintainable and suitable for reuse across applications or sites.
Code and configurations for use cases and interfaces that follow agreed versioning and delivery practices.
Documented components that Application Engineers can integrate, deploy and support.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Build and maintain application components:

Development and implementation of logic within the application components required to deliver approved application functionality and use cases.
Implement application features, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards.
Build and maintain within application domains such as IIoT, MES, SCADA, historians and maintenance systems.
Develop database structures and application interfaces in accordance with the approved design and relevant application practices.
Maintain existing applications and application components and adapt them when approved requirements or standards change.

Test and stabilise:

Take responsibility for the technical quality of the developments and configurations.
Create and execute developer-level tests and support broader functional and integration testing.
Identify, diagnose and correct defects discovered during implementation, testing and stabilisation.
Verify that the code deliverables meet the defined requirements and behave reliably in the target application environment.
Support Application Engineers during integration and deployment when code, configuration or component-level troubleshooting is required.

Reuse, standards and maintainability:

Ensure that development can be governed, maintained and reused beyond a single isolated requirement.
Use reusable logics, UX/UI and features where appropriate.
Follow agreed coding, configuration, naming and documentation standards,
Consider performance, reliability and maintainability when implementing application requirements.
Document code, configurations, dependencies and technical behaviour clearly enough for integration and support.

Controlled delivery and versioning:

Develop within the agreed versioning, review and release process.
Use Git or the agreed source-control platform for versioning and collaboration.
Follow the applicable CI/CD, code-review, testing and release practices
Maintain traceability between approved requirements, implemented changes and delivered versions.
Contribute to the correction and stabilisation of released components when development changes are required.

Collaboration across the application lifecycle:

Work with the Application Owner on approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Work with Application Engineers on technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs.
Clarify functional and technical requirements with the relevant business, engineering and architecture contributors.
Provide transparent estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status to the relevant delivery lead or Scrum Master.
Participate in defect resolution and technical discussions with vendors or system integrators when the developed components are involved.

Application-specific requirements:

SQL and application database development.
Programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning and collaborative development practices.
Implementation, testing, defect correction and feature stabilisation.
CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Creation and maintenance of technical documentation covering code, configurations, interfaces and delivered components.
Contribution across IIoT applications and use cases (including platforms such as Ignition), MES applications, historian and industrial-data applications, and maintenance applications, depending on the assigned application background.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Advanced: SQL and application database development, including database structures and application interfaces.
Advanced: programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Proficient: industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning, CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Working knowledge of secure software development lifecycle requirements under IEC 62443-4-1.
Working knowledge of application domains such as IIoT (including platforms such as Ignition), MES, historians and maintenance systems.

Behavioral Competencies:

Structured, pragmatic and quality-oriented, with strong ownership of the technical quality of own deliverables.
Constructive challenge of requirements, designs and technical solutions where quality or maintainability is at risk.
Clear cross-functional communication of estimates, risks, dependencies and delivery status across engineering, business and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in software, computer science, automation, electrical or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience developing and maintaining software components for industrial or manufacturing applications such as IIoT, MES, historians or maintenance systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated ownership of complex application components across multiple applications or sites.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany.
Home-based or hybrid working, including collaboration with nearshore and distributed delivery teams.
Occasional travel to manufacturing sites where development support is required.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Global OT Application Developer is accountable for:

Choosing detailed implementation approaches within approved requirements, architecture and standards.
Identifying technical risks and proposing improvements to components and delivery practices.
Raising concerns about potential future issues — technical debt, scalability, maintainability or obsolescence — to the Application Owner and architecture contributors before they affect operations.
Rejecting code or components that do not meet agreed quality and versioning practices.
Supporting integration, deployment and troubleshooting when development expertise is required.
The role does not own the application roadmap, backlog priorities or acceptance decisions, plant connectivity, site readiness, commissioning or operational support, and does not define platform architecture or approve material deviations from global standards; nor does it operate as an isolated programmer without testing, stabilisation and engineering collaboration.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Application Engineers: technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs; day-to-day collaboration throughout implementation and stabilisation.
Delivery lead / Scrum Master: estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status.
Business, engineering and architecture contributors: clarification of functional and technical requirements.
Vendors and system integrators: defect resolution and technical discussions where the developed components are involved.
Nearshore / distributed delivery teams: shared requirements, standards, testing, versioning and documentation practices; dotted-line collaboration with Application Engineers regardless of location.

Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive.
Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse.
LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung.
Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher.
Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung.

DEIN PROFIL

Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz.
Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit.
Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET.
LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle.
Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus.
Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

jobs.title: Global OT Application Engineer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Engineer implements, integrates, tests, deploys and supports industrial applications across manufacturing sites. The role configures and implements global use cases and applications.

The Application Engineer is the technical bridge between plants, application owners, developers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, software vendors and system integrators. The role covers both purchased or configured applications and internally built solutions; it is neither limited to software development nor to coordination.

Assigned scope:

Global OT applications across manufacturing sites, including MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT and CMMS domains.
Purchased, configured and internally developed applications and their interfaces to plant and business systems.

Primary emphasis:

Applications are deployed safely, consistently and with clear acceptance evidence.
Plant systems exchange accurate and reliable data through governed interfaces.
Sites receive effective onboarding, technical support and operational handover.
Incidents and recurring technical problems are resolved at the appropriate support level.
Global templates and standards are applied without losing control of necessary local adaptations.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Implementation and Integration:

Configure and implement applications, templates and technical components in accordance with the approved solution design.
Gather requirements to integrate applications with PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES/MOM, IIoT, historians and business systems such as ERP, LIMS or QMS.
Configure and troubleshoot industrial data exchange using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ensure that global libraries, naming conventions, templates, interfaces and deployment standards are followed.
Document any approved local deviation from the global template, including its justification and approval, in the application documentation.
Review technical and functional deliveries from developers, vendors and system integrators and challenge gaps in quality, maintainability or operability.

Testing and Validation:

Translate approved requirements and designs into a complete and traceable technical test scope.
Prepare and execute functional, integration and regression tests and support FAT, SAT and user acceptance testing.
Diagnose bugs, coordinate correction and test cycles, and maintain clear test evidence and release documentation.
Verify connectivity, data integrity, performance, resilience, security controls and operational readiness.
Confirm that acceptance criteria are met before recommending release or production deployment.

Deployment and Site Onboarding:

Lead the technical work required to take an application from a controlled release into stable plant operation.
Assess site readiness, infrastructure, signals, interfaces, data availability and local dependencies.
Coordinate technical activities with plant stakeholders, local OT teams, vendors and system integrators.
Execute or supervise installation, configuration, commissioning and cut-over activities.
Provide hypercare, technical training, documentation and a clear handover to support and site teams.

Operations and Support:

Provide ITIL-based L2/L3 application support: advanced troubleshooting, functional bug-fixing and technical incident escalation across sites (ITIL support levels, not Purdue Model network layers).
Perform problem management: conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for recurring application errors.
Manage technical change requests: oversee software modifications from assessment through testing, release and production deployment.
Monitor application health: track application performance, data interfaces (APIs) and support trends to recommend continuous improvements.
Maintain knowledge databases: manage technical documentation, application runbooks, release notes and Known-Error Databases (KEDB).

Plant and Technical Team Interface:

Act as the practical interface between plant operations and the teams that design, build and supply the applications.
Translate plant constraints and operational issues into actionable technical requirements and bugs.
Explain technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions to plant and business stakeholders.
Coordinate effectively with the Application Owner on priorities, scope, standards and acceptance.
Work with developers on build activities and with delivery leads or Scrum Masters on planning and execution.
Challenge vendors and system integrators on technical quality, delivery evidence and issue resolution, escalating commercial or roadmap matters to the Application Owner.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Strong knowledge of at least one relevant application domain: MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or CMMS, and of interfaces to PLC, SCADA and DCS systems.
Practical integration knowledge using OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ability to read, adapt or create components using Python, C#, Java or JavaScript when needed.
Working knowledge of versioning, release, incident, problem and change-management practices.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 principles, OT cybersecurity and regulated validation requirements where applicable.

Behavioral Competencies:

Plant-oriented, pragmatic and structured, with strong ownership of technical issues.
Constructive challenge of delivery evidence from developers, vendors and system integrators.
Clear cross-functional communication across plant, specialist and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in automation, electrical, software or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience with industrial applications, automation, MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or comparable manufacturing systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated responsibility across multiple sites or complex industrial programs.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany, plus a senior regional position in the north-eastern United States.
Home-based or hybrid working with regular domestic and international travel to manufacturing sites.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Application Engineer:

Together with the Project Managers, defines implementation and configuration approaches within approved standards.
Stops or rejects a technical deployment when readiness or acceptance criteria are not met.
Recommends fixes, improvements and standard changes based on operational evidence.
Escalates architecture, security, scope and vendor-performance risks.
The role does not own application strategy, roadmap, backlog or commercial vendor decisions, does not act only as a software developer without integration, testing, support and site responsibilities, does not replace the plant's operational ownership or bypass agreed OT governance, and does not approve material deviations from global standards without the relevant owner or authority.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: priorities, scope, standards, acceptance and escalation of commercial or roadmap matters.
Plant operations and local OT teams: site readiness, deployment activities, onboarding, training, support and operational handover.
Developers, delivery leads and Scrum Masters: build activities, defect resolution, planning and release execution.
Infrastructure and cybersecurity teams: interfaces, security controls, architecture dependencies and technical risk.
Software vendors and system integrators: technical quality, delivery evidence, testing and issue resolution.
Business and functional stakeholders (production, quality, maintenance, supply chain): technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions affecting plant operations.
Project managers: rollout planning and execution; sequencing, dependencies and escalation of deviations.

Company Overview

EthiFinance is an independent European credit and sustainability rating agency, fully committed to sustainable finance. Founded in Paris, the group supports investors, banks, insurance companies and corporates with high-impact analysis, ratings, data and advisory services to help them navigate environmental and societal transformation.

Following the recent combination with ESG Book, EthiFinance is entering a new chapter of growth and international expansion. Operating under the EthiFinance brand, the combined group brings together complementary expertise in sustainability, credit ratings, data, analytics and technology to create a leading independent European player with global capabilities.

Today, the group brings together more than 300 experts across Europe, the United States, India and Japan, serving more than 500 clients and providing coverage on more than 10,000 companies worldwide. This unique combination of financial expertise, ESG intelligence and technology enables us to support financial institutions and corporates in an increasingly complex and fast-evolving market environment.

As the sustainable finance market continues to evolve, EthiFinance is building a strong European alternative that combines deep local expertise with international reach, helping clients better understand and manage both financial and non-financial risks.

Context

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Technology team and contribute to the ongoing development of our sustainability data platform.

Reporting to an Engineering Manager, you will play a key role in designing, building and improving the systems that power our products and services. Working closely with product managers, engineers and other stakeholders, you will contribute to the development of scalable, reliable and secure solutions while supporting the continuous evolution of our technology landscape.

This role offers the opportunity to work in an international and collaborative environment, where technology, innovation and sustainability come together to support the future of sustainable finance.

Key responsibilities

Software Development & Architecture

Design, develop and maintain scalable software solutions supporting our SaaS platform.
Contribute to the architecture and evolution of distributed and cloud-native systems.
Build high-quality, secure and maintainable code following engineering best practices.
Participate in technical design discussions and architectural decision-making.

Platform & Cloud Engineering

Develop and maintain APIs and backend services.
Contribute to cloud infrastructure, deployment automation and CI/CD pipelines.
Support the reliability, performance and scalability of production systems.
Work with containerized environments and modern cloud technologies.

Collaboration & Delivery

Collaborate closely with Product, Data and Engineering teams to deliver business value.
Participate in agile ceremonies and contribute to planning and prioritisation activities within your squad.
Support cross-functional initiatives and technical projects across the organization.
Promote engineering excellence and knowledge sharing within the team.

Mentoring & Continuous Improvement

Provide guidance and mentoring to junior team members.
Contribute to code reviews and engineering standards.
Drive continuous improvement of development processes, tools and ways of working.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry best practices.

Profile required

5+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
Strong experience with backend development (Golang, Java, C#, Python or similar technologies).
Experience designing and delivering scalable software solutions in a cloud environment.
Solid understanding of API design and distributed systems.
Experience with CI/CD practices and infrastructure automation.
Familiarity with Docker and ideally also Kubernetes.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and international teams.
Fluent English is required.

Nice to have:

Experience with event-driven architectures, microservices or Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience with AI-enabled or agentic development approaches.
Experience with AngularJS or full-stack development.

Why Join Us?

Join a fast-growing international group at the intersection of finance, sustainability and technology.
Contribute to products that support more transparent and sustainable financial markets.
Work alongside talented colleagues in a collaborative and inclusive environment.
Enjoy significant autonomy and ownership in your role.
Access learning and development opportunities to support your career growth.
Benefit from a hybrid working model and international exposure.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Reliable data, resilient services and scalable architectures are at the heart of every CRM interaction at idealo. As a Staff Engineer,
you'll shape the technical foundation behind identity resolution, subscriptions, data flows, and message delivery while ensuring GDPR compliance and supporting personalized user experiences.

This role combines backend engineering, data engineering and architectural leadership
. You'll influence how data flows across systems, how services communicate through event-driven architectures, and how technical decisions support idealo's long-term CRM strategy. Working closely with Software Engineers, Data Engineers and Product Managers, you'll help define technical direction across multiple domains.

You'll work with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Braze, Snowflake and AWS services including Glue, Lambda and S3 in a modern cloud-native architecture
. From data ingestion and transformation to customer-facing activation, you'll help build reliable systems that teams across idealo depend on every day. When new CRM capabilities go live, you'll see the direct impact of your work in millions of customer interactions.

The position is available in full or part-time.

About Your New Role

Design, implement, maintain, and evolve reliable and scalable software systems and data flows for CRM and user engagement use cases. 
Stay hands-on by designing and developing cloud-native microservices, event-driven applications and backend services with a strong focus on performance, security and operational excellence.
Lead technical initiatives within and across the team to align technical solutions with business needs.
Drive continuous improvements across software development, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, observability, and monitoring while evaluating new technologies where they add measurable value.
Mentor engineers through technical guidance, architecture discussions and code reviews, fostering a collaborative engineering culture focused on sustainable technical excellence.

Job Requirements

Skills & Requirements

You bring extensive experience building cloud-native software systems on AWS and designing distributed, event-driven architectures using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Kafka and modern backend technologies.
You have deep expertise in data architecture, data warehousing, ETL processes and data integration, combined with hands-on experience working with technologies such as Glue, S3 and MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
You are experienced with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes, and are familiar with serverless architectures, AWS Lambda and modern CI/CD practices.
You have a strong understanding of software quality, security and reliability, including authentication, encryption, automated testing and secure software development practices.
You have a proven track record of leading complex technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions and aligning engineering work across teams without formal people management responsibility.
You take ownership and independently drive topics forward. The Confidence to speak up and challenge ideas constructively, paired with openness to diverse perspectives.

At idealo you can expect

You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.
And what about the office? Our office in the heart of Berlin offers free organic breakfast, excellent free lunch (vegan and vegetarian), as well as free coffee, lemonades and after-work beer, in addition to the "standard foosball". It also has a fabulous rooftop terrace with view of the whole of berlin where you can network with colleagues from our group of companies.
In need of additional support in any areas of your life? We offer free counseling and support in all areas of life (professional, private, family, health, etc.) in cooperation with the pme-Familienservice.
You want full flexibility on your way to work and beyond? No problem with a job bike or Deutschlandticket - and it's environmentally friendly, too!
Want to keep yourself fit? We offer many different fitness and sports options, such as an Urban Sports or Gympass membership, to suit your personal needs.
And what else is there? Of course, success must be celebrated! In addition to team events, you can also expect big company events and other moments of organized connection with others in the company and your team throughout the year!

Referment is working with a financial technology business that provides banks with the data intelligence behind personalised digital banking. Its platform runs in demanding client environments, with much of the estate currently deployed on-premises and an active migration towards cloud.

As Principal Architect, you'll own the architecture of the whole platform: services, data, integrations, deployment models and the boundaries between them. Reporting directly to the CTO, you'll set technical direction, make difficult trade-offs and remain accountable for whether the architecture supports the business as it scales.

The business is undertaking a funded platform transformation spanning performance, architecture and AI. This is not a review-and-advise position or a programme management role. You'll draft the target architecture, defend it with engineers and customers, and stay close to implementation so you can correct drift early. The work is about shaping the technical outcome while ensuring today's delivery remains consistent with the platform's longer-term direction.

The Role

Define and own the target architecture, establishing the platform structure and clear service boundaries that engineers can use to make implementation decisions.
Shape the technical transformation from on-premises to cloud, from MSSQL to PostgreSQL and from legacy systems to a coherent platform. Stay close enough to delivery to identify divergence before it becomes entrenched.
Document architectural decisions through RFCs, architecture decision records and technical strategy. Write clearly enough that teams can understand the rationale, resolve debates and act on the agreed direction.
Embed AI as a first-class architectural concern across services, data pipelines and the software development lifecycle, rather than treating it only as an additional feature.
Explain and defend the architecture with both internal engineers and bank-side architects, balancing technical credibility with clear communication about trade-offs.
Make decisions that work across on-premises client installations and cloud environments, maintaining practical awareness of both during the migration.

What We're Looking For

Ownership of a distributed, data-heavy platform architecture in production, with significant customer expectations. Designing a system in isolation is not enough; you should be able to explain how your decisions held up in operation.
Experience moving a live system from one architecture to another without stopping the business, with an honest account of the costs, compromises and lessons.
Deep C# and .NET knowledge, strong MSSQL and PostgreSQL experience, and practical exposure to both on-premises and cloud systems. You'll need to read implementation code critically, not operate solely at diagram level.
Hands-on understanding of Azure, Kafka, Kubernetes, Helm charts and distributed systems at scale.
Clear technical writing, demonstrated through RFCs, decision records or public technical communication. You should be able to turn an architectural judgement into an explicit, usable decision.

to join our team in Poland, with a passion for building secure, scalable, and high-performance backend systems. In this role, you’ll focus on leveraging Java and modern frameworks to develop innovative solutions, ensure system security, and work with cutting-edge cloud technologies. You can work from our modern office in Gliwice or remotely from anywhere in Poland, with a visit to the office at least once per month to meet the team.

What You’ll Be Doing

Backend Development

Build and maintain scalable backend systems and APIs using Java.
Design and implement microservices architectures to ensure reliability and scalability.
Use frameworks such as Spring Boot or Micronaut to implement modular and efficient services.
Integrate LLM APIs and AI agent workflows directly into Java microservices to support autonomous commerce logic.
Build and maintain event-driven pipelines that stream real-time transaction data into AI decision engines.

Regularly scan for vulnerabilities using tools like OWASP Dependency-Check and mitigate identified risks.

Cloud Integration

Deploy and optimize backend services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using Kubernetes, Cloud Storage, and Compute Engine.
Contribute to the design of cloud-native, high-availability architectures.

Collaboration and Optimization

Work closely with cross-functional teams, including frontend developers and system architects, to deliver robust solutions.
Continuously enhance system performance for high availability and fault tolerance.
Optimize service throughput, latency, and queue processing to reliably handle asynchronous AI/ML workloads.

Documentation

Produce detailed documentation for system architecture, APIs, and security protocols to ensure long-term maintainability.

What We’re Looking For

Experience:
You have 4+ years of hands-on experience with Java
development and building large-scale, high-performance backend systems.
Education:
You hold a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
Architecture:
Proven experience designing microservices-based systems optimized for complex or data-intensive environments, with familiarity in Event Sourcing and distributed system patterns.
Cloud & Databases:
You have hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (including Kubernetes and Compute Engine), NoSQL databases (especially MongoDB), and messaging systems (like Pub/Sub).
Integrations:
Experience with integration and workflow systems like Make or n8n.
Security:
Strong understanding of OWASP standards, encryption, and secure coding practices.
Mindset & Autonomy:
You are able to work autonomously while delivering innovative, AI-enabled backend solutions.
Communication:
You communicate effectively in both Polish and English (minimum B2 level).

Bonus Points

AI Stack:
Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs, vector databases, or AI framework integrations in Java.
Additional Languages:
Experience with Go is a plus.

Why You’ll Love It Here

An Amazing Team & Culture (Our Best Asset!):
We aim high and build rapidly, but we do it together. You will join an incredible, high-trust, and psychologically safe workplace where people truly care for one another. We collaborate closely, support each other unconditionally, and genuinely have fun doing what we do.
Cutting-Edge Technology:
Work on advanced microservices architectures and leverage the latest tools in cloud computing, DevOps, and AI to create groundbreaking solutions.
Autonomy and Innovation:
Enjoy the freedom to explore new ideas, experiment with innovative technologies, and influence the technical direction of a rapidly growing company.
Collaborative Culture:
Join a team of talented professionals who value knowledge-sharing, open communication, and a passion for building exceptional systems.
Flexible Work Setup:
Enjoy a hybrid work model that promotes flexibility and personal well-being while encouraging collaboration and meaningful team connections. (Meet in our Gliwice office at least once a month.)
Impactful Contribution:
Be part of a company where your work directly impacts the success of a next-generation commerce platform used by top-tier businesses.

Come as you are:
We are building an AI-driven future for commerce, and above all, we believe great software is built by great teams. Most importantly, we look for good people who work exceptionally well together—proactive, positive team players who bring great energy to problem-solving. Emporix is an equal opportunity employer, and even if you don’t check every single box, but eager to build scalable Java backend systems alongside a supportive team, we’d love to meet you.

13,500 – 22,500 PLN / month (Gross)
B2B Contract:
16,000 – 27,000 PLN / month Net (+ VAT)

At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.

What your team does:

The Payments Platform Team builds and runs the payment engine behind every purchase on Qliro - payment transactions, integrations with our Payment Service Providers, and settlements consolidation for our merchants. We operate on the transactional frontline, where high availability and performance aren't optional.

Our tech stack includes:

Är du en driven och engagerad utvecklare? Vill du utveckla digitala tjänster i en transaktionsintensiv domän inom Fintech?

Då låter det som att du kan vara vår nya teammedlem!

OM ROLLEN OCH TEAMET

Du kommer att ingå i ett litet, ödmjukt och självgående DevOps-team. Vi har ett gemensamt helhetsansvar för systemutveckling, test, deployment, drift och underhåll. Vi sätter ett högt värde i kvalitativ kod med god läsbarhet.

Teamet jobbar både med nyutveckling och underhåll av befintliga system och tjänster. Det dagliga arbetet präglas av kvalitet och säkerhet. Samtliga tjänster utvecklas mot och driftas i Azure.

Du kommer bli en viktig del av teamet där vi tillsammans tar fram högkvalitativa och datadrivna lösningar, i ett nära samarbete med andra utvecklingsteam samt stakeholders i verksamheten.

För att trivas i rollen och i teamet behöver du vara en genuin lagspelare. För oss innebär det att vi hjälper och sporrar våra kollegor, samtidigt som vi vågar ifrågasätta tidigare antaganden och lösningar. Dessutom är det viktigt att vi har kul tillsammans.

OM DIG

Du är pragmatisk, nyfiken och prestigelös. Du har en passion för att leverera lösningar och robusta system av hög kvalitet och säkerhet.

Vi tror att du är en utvecklare med minst fem års erfarenhet av backend-utveckling, och att du har gedigen kompetens inom C#, .NET, Azure och SQL. Du har en god förmåga att skapa strukturerad och lättläst kod och är van vid att använda AI i utvecklingsprocessen. Du har tidigare arbetat i molnet och har erfarenhet av Infrastruktur i Azure.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av eller intresse för Blazor, Bicep, Terraform och cybersäkerhet.

Koncernspråket är svenska och dokumentation sker på svenska och för att lyckas i rollen behöver du kommunicera på svenska flytande.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som föregås av provanställning, med start enligt överenskommelse.

På Norion Bank arbetar vi enligt en hybrid-setup med både kontorsarbete och distansarbete. Kontorsarbetet sker på vårt fina huvudkontor vid Lilla Bommen i Göteborg. Där sitter våra team tillsammans vilket främjar både kommunikation och samarbete.

NORION BANKS ERBJUDANDE TILL DIG

För oss är det självklart att varje individs utveckling värdesätts högt vilket innebär ett stort fokus på självledarskap och kompetensutveckling. Gemenskap, innovation och modern arbetsmetodik är saker som kännetecknar Norion Bank Group. Vi erbjuder dig helt enkelt en organisation med snabba beslutsvägar, stor öppenhet och mycket energi.

Vi erbjuder dig ett spännande bolag med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, löpande kompetensutveckling och gemensamma aktiviteter på och utanför arbetsplatsen.

REKRYTERINGSPROCESSEN

Vi vill att vår rekryteringsprocess ska vara rättvis och inkluderande. Därför ber vi dig att inte bifoga foto eller annan information som inte är relevant för tjänsten. Personligt brev är inget krav.

I samtliga rekryteringsprocesser genomför Norion Bank bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidaten. Bakgrundskontrollen innefattar bland annat ekonomisk information, juridisk information och bosättningsuppgifter.

Norion Bank kommer att behandla dina personuppgifter i enlighet med gällande dataskyddslagstiftning. Läs mer om vår hantering av personuppgifter och dina rättigheter på https://karriar.norionbank.se/data-privacy

Vi undanber oss kontakt med rekryteringsbolag, konsultbolag samt annonsörer i rekryteringen.

INTRESSERAD?

Kul! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande så ansök redan idag!

Frågor? Välkommen att höra av dig till oss!

För frågor kring teamet och rollen, kontakta gärna Karin Lidberg, Head of Development Finance & Debt IT, på karin.lidberg@norionbank.se

För frågor om oss som arbetsgivare eller rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta gärna Jesper Östlund, HR Business Partner på jesper.ostlund@norionbank.se

Norion Bank Group är en affärsnära nordisk finansieringsbank. Genom koncernens varumärken Norion Bank, Walley och Collector erbjuds kundanpassade finansieringstjänster som möter distinkta kundbehov inom tre kundsegment: medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag, handlare och privatpersoner. Som specialist på finansieringslösningar är Norion Bank Group ett ledande komplement till traditionella storbanker, med visionen att vara den främsta nordiska finansieringsbanken inom de utvalda segmenten.

Norion Banks erbjudande omfattar företags- och fastighetskrediter samt factoring för medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag. Genom varumärket Walley erbjuds flexibla betal- och checkoutlösningar till handlare och privatpersoner. Varumärket Collector tillhandahåller privatlån och kreditkort till privatpersoner samt sparkonton för privatpersoner och företag. Norion Bank (tidigare Collector Bank) grundades 1999 och har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg, Oslo och Helsingfors. Verksamheten bedrivs genom Norion Bank AB (publ) som är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm.

Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.

Jobbeskrivning

Är du en helt vanlig eller ovanlig back-end-utvecklare, som vill ha roligt på jobbet, samarbeta med andra, bidra med din kompetens, ha en stöttande chef och vara del av ett riktigt härligt team i Uppsala?
Bra, för precis det kan vi erbjuda dig!

I din roll som konsult kommer du att vara ansvarig för att utveckla och underhålla back-end-komponenter i olika projekt. Rollen innebär att arbeta både självständigt och i team, t.ex. genom att ensam eller tillsammans med kollegor ta ansvar för hela back-end-delen av ett projekt.

Vi driver både små och stora projekt från Uppsala och har kunder inom flera olika branscher, t.ex. offentlig sektor och samhällsviktig verksamhet. Din vardag kommer se lite olika ut beroende på projekt, kund och uppdrag - och den variationen tror jag att du tycker känns kul!

På kontoret i Uppsala finns ca 50 personer inom IT och digitalisering - det vill säga gott om både juniora och seniora kollegor att ta hjälp av.

Kvalifikationer

Dina tekniska färdigheter är förstås viktiga men vad du har att bidra med som person är lika viktigt det. I den här rollen behöver du t.ex. trivas med att samarbeta i team och dela ut och ta emot feedback, tycka att det är intressant när omständigheter förändras (t.ex. att du behöver lära dig en ny teknik eller nya arbetsuppgifter, byta kund, team eller projekt etc.), du motiveras av att hjälpa andra (t.ex. föreslå en teknisk förändring som är till hjälp för kunden) och du drar dig inte för att själv ta hjälp om du kör fast.

För att komma in med rätt tekniska förutsättningar tror vi att du:

Har minst 3 års erfarenhet av C#/.NET-utveckling
Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med REST API:er
Har erfarenhet av Azure och kunskap om DevOps och dess processer
Har erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server

Meriterande:

Erfarenhet av WPF
Erfarenhet av containerteknik (Podman, Kubernetes)
Erfarenhet av testdriven utveckling (TDD)
Erfarenhet av GIS

Utöver det är du svensk medborgare* och behärskar svenska i tal och skrift, då svenska krävs i kontakt med kollegor och kunder. Ett extra plus i kanten om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som konsult!

För vissa uppdrag hos myndighet, region eller kommun krävs svenskt medborgarskap och godkänd säkerhetsprövning.

Ytterligare information

Välkommen med din ansökan, sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-30

Rebecka Gravås
, Gruppchef

rebecka.gravas@afry.com

Tel: 072 205 8117

Konkurrenskraftiga villkor med förmåner som kollektivavtal, friskvård, företagsrabatter, pensionsplanering och generösa föräldraledighetsregler.
Ett stort nätverk av kompetenta kollegor i Sverige och internationellt.

Jag berättar gärna mer om våra förmåner under en intervju!

jobs.description:
Job Description

What if your leadership could shape large-scale, business-critical digital products across a global organization? At H&M Tech, the Engineering Manager plays a critical leadership role, accountable for technical execution, delivery quality, and operational excellence.

The Product domain provides capabilities to design, create, source, and produce customer‑relevant assortments. It covers the full product lifecycle from product design, sourcing, purchasing, to production execution, and is organized into four focus areas that each own a distinct part of this lifecycle. The Product team will support the Production Office with technology and data use cases that help colleagues explore opportunities, improve decision-making, automate manual work, and create measurable value in production processes.

We are currently recruiting for 3 Engineering Manager positions
within our Product domain. These opportunities span the Product & Purchase
and Product Sourcing
areas, where you will lead one of our engineering teams supporting Sourcing Partnership Flow, Purchase Flow, or Labels & Tags

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Strategic & Delivery Leadership

Own end-to-end technical delivery for one or more large-scale and complex products or services.
In service contexts, own both roadmap and delivery accountability; in product contexts, partner with Product Managers to shape execution.
Translate business and product goals into clear technical direction, execution plans, and measurable outcomes across technology and data-enabled products.
Partner with Production Office stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver technology and data use cases that solve real operational needs and improve ways of working.
Work in close dual leadership with the Product Manager to balance product priorities, technical feasibility, delivery capacity, and long-term scalability.
Secure and allocate engineering capacity across multiple teams aligned with strategic priorities.
Establish scalable, secure, and resilient data platforms, pipelines, and data products that support analytics, experimentation, and operational use cases.
Lead through senior engineers while retaining overall accountability for engineering quality, delivery timelines, consistent standards, and operational excellence.

Operational Excellence

Shape and enforce engineering quality, simplification, and continuous improvement across teams.
Define and monitor KPIs to drive operational performance and business outcomes.
Ensure stable, resilient, compliant, and secure operations, including effective incident handling and adherence to architectural standards.
Lead proactive management of risks, dependencies, and technical debt.
Embed responsible technology practices into delivery, including privacy, security, bias awareness, monitoring, and clear operational ownership.
Oversee vendor and managed service delivery, ensuring performance, compliance, contractual alignment, and cost efficiency.

Financial Accountability

Own and manage tech costs (budget, forecast, actuals) across large-scale products or services.
Ensure strong financial discipline and cost efficiency aligned with TCO objectives.
Contribute to investment planning and prioritization aligned with business goals.

People & Culture

Lead, coach, mentor, and develop senior engineers, leaders, and teams while setting best practices for engineering excellence.
Build high-performing, inclusive, and psychologically safe environments in the team.
Ensure teams have the right competencies, structure, and support to succeed.
Promote sustainable ways of working and support team well-being.

Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a senior technical leader influencing enterprise-level decisions and priorities.
Collaborate with product, architecture, security, and business stakeholders to align direction.

Ensure transparency with clear communication of progress, risks, and dependencies.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will lead an engineering team within one of our Product Tech areas—Product & Purchase or Product Sourcing—supporting one of the strategic product teams: Sourcing Partnership Flow, Purchase Flow, or Labels & Tags. You will lead a Product team consisting of various Engineers and operate at the intersection of engineering, data, product, architecture, and business. The team will work closely with the Production Office to understand concrete use cases, shape scalable data and technology solutions, and turn business needs into reliable products that support production teams in their daily work.

You will work in dual leadership with the Product Manager, where you bring engineering leadership, delivery accountability, technical direction, and operational excellence while the Product Manager drives product vision, prioritization, and value realization. Together, you will align priorities, shape the roadmap, and ensure data and digital capabilities are designed, built, governed, and scaled across the Product in close collaboration with architects, specialists, security, analytics, and senior stakeholders.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an experienced 10+ years
engineering leader with a strong track record of delivering complex, large-scale technology solutions. You bring deep technical understanding combined with impactful leadership, enabling teams and leaders to perform at their best.

You thrive in complexity and ambiguity, confidently making trade-offs that balance short-term delivery with long-term scalability, resilience, and quality.

You bring:

Strong experience in s
oftware development, with a solid hands-on background in .NET / C#
.
Strong experience working with Microsoft Azure
and cloud-based technologies.
Corporate leadership experience with direct budget responsibility,
including planning, forecasting, prioritization, cost management and accountability for budget outcomes.
Proven people leadership experience, including recruitment, performance management, coaching, feedback and employee development.
Ownership of delivery outcomes from planning through execution, with accountability for scope, timeline, quality, risks and dependencies.
Engineering leadership in a corporate custom software development environment using Microsoft technologies, including Azure.
Strong technical understanding of modern engineering practices, including agile, DevOps, scalable architecture, cloud platforms, and confidence working closely with engineers on technical decisions and delivery.
Ability to balance business value, technical feasibility, delivery capacity, and long-term scalability while creating clarity across product, engineering, architecture, and business.
Experience working with vendors and external partners.

WHO WE ARE
​

H&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

Help us re-imagine fashion and together we will re-shape our industry. Learn more about H&M here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
​

At H&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

We offer all our employees at H&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment types and countries.

JOIN US
​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

Om rollen

Det här är en renodlad programmeringsroll. Du kommer att jobba i kärnan av plattformens kodbas: arkitektur, rendering, UI och prestanda. Stora mängder geologisk data och 3D-modeller ska laddas snabbt, renderas snyggt och gå att navigera flytande i realtid. Det är den typen av problem du kommer att lösa. Utveckla nya funktioner i plattformen i Unity och C#, från design av lösningen till färdig, testad kod

Profilera och optimera rendering, minne och laddtider så att stora datamängder flyter i realtid
Skriva shaders och renderingskod som gör geologisk data tydlig och visuellt övertygande
Bidra till våra interna verktyg och datapipelines (Unity Editor, Blender, databaser, GIS) som gör det snabbare att få in kunddata i plattformen

Vi söker dig som

Har minst tre års arbetslivserfarenhet som programmerare. Bakgrund som spelprogrammerare fungerar bra, bakgrund som system- eller grafikprogrammerare är ännu bättre.
Kan Unity och C# på djupet, det är kärnan i allt vi bygger
Har jobbat med UI Toolkit
Är van att profilera och optimera Unity-applikationer
Skriver shaders. Shader Graph är okej, HLSL eller motsvarande är bättre.

Bor i Göteborg eller är redo att flytta hit. Rollen är på plats på kontoret.

God engelska i tal och skrift, eftersom våra kunder är internationella
Webbutveckling och Python

Import och hantering av databaser
Egenutvecklade verktyg för Unity Editor

GIS

Vem är du?

Du brinner sannolikt lite extra för teknik och ser det därför som en naturlig del att hålla dig uppdaterad om vad som händer och trendar inom teknikens värld.

Genom ditt driv och ansvarstagande ser du till att våra kunder får bästa möjliga lösning som stödjer deras verksamhet. Du är även en prestigelös lagspelare och kan leda olika konstellationer av utvecklingsteam.

Vi söker dig som

har 4-8 års erfarenhet av design och utveckling av BI-lösningar
har erfarenhet av att implementera datalösningar i Azure, exempelvis Azure Synapse, Databricks, Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Microsoft Fabric & Data Vault
har lång erfarenhet av informations- och datamodellering
har hands-on erfarenhet av programmering inom SQL och Python
har arbetat med stora datamängder med distribuerade ramverk, som till exempel spark
har förmåga att översätta kundens unika behov till en arkitektur och implementera denna
har vana att leda dina utvecklar-kollegor med utgångspunkt i både nuläge och målbild av arkitekturen
talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Ett plus om du har erfarenhet av

Data Vault & DBT (Data Build Tool)
Azure, exempelvis Microsoft Fabric
Power BI
ML och AI lösningar

Team Data Driven Transformation - Vilka är vi?

I team Data-Driven Transformation arbetar vi tillsammans med våra kunder för att skapa värde av data, och i sin tur framgångsrika människor och organisationer med tryggare beslutsfattande och effektivare arbetssätt. Vårt mål är att hitta den perfekta mixen av professionalism och entreprenörsanda för att på bästa sätt bidra till våra kunders verksamhet med både kompetens och kreativitet.

Vi agerar rådgivare och teknisk partner inom data-drivna system där vi även designar och implementerar tekniska lösningar för machine learning och advanced analytics. Detta kan till exempel vara att samla, strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data, visuellt designa rapporter och möjliggöra ett mer proaktivt beslutsfattande. Andra exempel är maskininlärningsmodeller för att personifiera innehåll på hemsidor, analysera kundbeteenden samt optimera morgondagens energi och produktionssystem.

Vårt team innehåller en härlig mix av både erfarna förmågor och nyare talanger. Tillsammans skapar vi energi och glädje i både leveranser och interna initiativ. För att sporra och utveckla varandra som både kollegor och konsulter skapar vi tillfällen för både kompetensutveckling på jobbet och sociala aktiviteter i olika former.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Nyfiken?
Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss genom att maila: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

Strong verbal and presentational skills
Strong Python or C# programming skills
Knowledgeable in infrastructure-as-code (CDK/Terraform).
Experience working with Iceberg, versioning etc.
A product-oriented mindset, focused on building durable, scalable solutions rather than one-off pipelines.

At Olink, Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will be part of a nurturing team that values integrity, innovation, and involvement. We offer an encouraging environment where your diverse experiences and perspectives are appreciated, enabling you to thrive and excel in your career.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Har du erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och testa lösningar inom avancerad analys? Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär med möjligheter och utveckling som ledord? Vill du, precis som vi, skapa affärsdrivna end-to-end lösningar som gör verklig skillnad? Då ser vi fram emot att höra ifrån dig!

Vem är du?

Du har ett genuint teknikintresse och drivs av att utvecklas tillsammans med ditt team. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och är nyfiken på att lära dig av andra. Du är trygg i att ta ansvar för uppgifter där du får strukturera och identifiera affärsmässiga samt tekniska mål, och driva arbetet framåt. Du har lätt för att kommunicera resultat till olika målgrupper, oavsett teknisk nivå och du tar gärna ansvar för leveranser från start till mål.

Du är lösningsorienterad och ser alltid till att kunden får den bästa möjliga lösningen. Eftersom tjänsten även innehåller en och annan fika, tror vi att du gillar att nätverka med kollegor och tillsammans utforska nya idéer, erbjudanden och tjänster. Du är en lagspelare som gärna stöttar dina kollegor när behov uppstår.

Du brinner för att designa, implementera och agera rådgivare inom datalösningar för avancerad analys. Med en operativ inställning omfamnar du DevOps/MLOps och har ett starkt fokus på automation och end-to-end ägarskap.

Vi vill jobba med dig som

har 3+ års erfarenhet av design, utveckling och testning av avancerade BI-lösningar.
har erfarenhet av att implementera lösningar i exempelvis Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake & Snowflake.
har hands-on erfarenhet av programmering inom SQL och Python.
har erfarenhet av att hantera stora datamängder med hjälp av distribuerade ramverk, såsom Apache Spark, för att möjliggöra skalbar och effektiv databehandling.
behärskar svenska och engelska.
har erfarenhet av att utveckla Power BI-rapporter.

Ett plus om du har erfarenhet av

Data Vault
DBT (Data Build Tool)
Machine Learning och AI lösningar

Vårt team

I teamet Data-Driven Transformation samarbetar vi nära med våra kunder för att omvandla data till konkret värde vilket leder till tryggare beslut, effektivare arbetssätt och framgångsrika organisationer.

Vår ambition är att kombinera professionalism och entreprenörsanda och därigenom bidra med både kompetens och kreativitet. Vi strävar efter att vara en partner som inte bara levererar lösningar, utan också inspirerar till utveckling.

Vi är både rådgivare och teknisk partner inom data-drivna system, från design till implementation av lösningar för såväl avancerad analys som machine learning. Det kan handla om att samla in, strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data, skapa visuella rapporter eller möjliggöra mer proaktivt beslutsfattande.

Vårt team innehåller en dynamisk mix av erfarna experter och nya talanger, vilket skapar både energi och arbetsglädje i våra leveranser och interna initiativ. Vi tror på att växa tillsammans genom kompetensutveckling, kunskapsdelning och sociala aktiviteter som stärker både teamkänsla och konsultrollen.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Nyfiken?
Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

jobs.description:

System Developer/ Tester på Advania 🚀

På ADSS MSP arbetar vi med att utveckla, vidareutveckla och förvalta tekniska lösningar. Vi arbetar nära verksamheten och fokuserar på att skapa stabila system och hållbara leveranser.

I rollen som System Developer/Tester arbetar du med både utveckling och testning som en del av teamets dagliga arbete. Målbilden är en ungefärlig fördelning mellan utveckling och test, men fokus varierar utifrån teamets behov.

Det innebär att du arbetar med att:

Utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i Java
Arbeta praktiskt med testning som en del av teamets leveranser
Arbeta med API:er och integrationer
Felsöka och lösa problem i befintliga lösningar

Utöver det ovan ansvarar du även för att:

Driva egna utvecklings- och testuppgifter framåt
Delta i code reviews och teamets gemensamma utvecklingsarbete
Bidra i ett agilt arbetssätt med sprintar, daily standups och CI/CD
Bygga upp kunskap om den tekniska miljön och de verktyg som används i teamet

Rollen är baserad i Malmö. Teamet består av cirka 5-6 kollegor som arbetar nära varandra och hjälps åt genom att diskutera lösningar, dela kunskap och stötta varandra i vardagen.

Det som kännetecknar rollen är kombinationen av utveckling och test. Du arbetar med båda delarna i praktiken och får möjlighet att utvecklas inom ett brett tekniskt område samtidigt som du tar ett större eget ansvar över tid.

Vad vi söker hos dig ✨

För att trivas och passa hos oss har du en bakgrund inom Javautveckling och testning. Du kan idag arbeta som exempelvis Systemutvecklare, Javautvecklare, Testutvecklare eller Software Developer. För oss är det viktigare vad du har arbetat med och kan idag än exakt hur många år du har varit i branschen.

Som person tycker du om att förstå hur saker fungerar och tar ansvar för att få dina uppgifter framåt. Du försöker hitta lösningar på problem, men är också bekväm med att be om hjälp eller diskutera olika alternativ tillsammans med kollegor när det behövs.

Du trivs i en miljö där människor samarbetar, delar kunskap och hjälper varandra framåt.

Vi söker dig som har:

Praktisk erfarenhet av Java
Praktisk erfarenhet av testning
Erfarenhet av eller förståelse för API-utveckling
Kunskap om Linux
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

Spring Boot
Git
Microservices
Kubernetes
Unit testing frameworks
Bash eller annan scripting
Kafka eller Spark
Gradle, Azure DevOps, Postman, Insomnia eller Grafana

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! 👋

Visa gärna ditt intresse så snart som möjligt då vi intervjuar löpande. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och synsätt, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och stärker såväl effektivitet som kreativitet i vårt arbete.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en obligatorisk bakgrundskontroll, en för oss kvalitativ kontroll inför ett anställningsbeslut. Advania samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg i ärenden kopplat till alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad "Proaktiv Arbetsplats".

Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor eller funderingar.

Det är du som arbetar nära kunden som vet vad dem behöver och vad som blir den bästa lösningen för just deras unika behov, både i dag och i morgon. Därför tycker vi att det är du som ska fatta besluten. Det är genom att erbjuda säkra, hållbara och kundanpassade lösningar som vi skapar värde för kunderna och samhället i stort.

Vi bryr oss om hur våra medarbetare mår – på riktigt. Därför samarbetar Advania med Ljung & Sjöberg för att skapa en trygg, proaktiv arbetsmiljö med stöd kring alkohol-, drog- och beroenderelaterade frågor. Tillsammans bygger vi en hållbar arbetsplats där det är okej att be om hjälp, och där förebyggande arbete gör skillnad – för individen, teamet och företaget.

I en miljö präglad av stort kundfokus och frihet under ansvar blir det extra viktigt för oss att bygga starka team bestående av ödmjuka stjärnor. Att arbeta i en inkluderande miljö, med kollegor och kunder som vill utvecklas, ger oss möjligheten att trivas och ha riktigt roligt på jobbet. Vi tror på en platt organisation med agilt arbetssätt och flexibilitet. Detta är det enda sättet för en hållbar framtid.

Advania Sverige, ”The tech company with people at heart”, har kontor över hela landet, från Luleå i norr till Malmö i syd. Dagligen hjälper våra 1 700 specialister våra kunder, både inom privat och offentlig sektor, i deras ambitioner och mål att digitalisera sina verksamheter. Genom långsiktiga relationer, ledande teknologier, moderna plattformslösningar och strategiska partnerskap formar vi framtidens IT-landskap. Vårt syfte sträcker sig bortom teknik: att ge människor kraften att skapa hållbara värden.

Advaniagruppen levererar tjänster till kunder i Sverige, Norge, Storbritannien, Island, Finland och Danmark inom hållbar och säker digitalisering.

Job Description

Team Overview

GM’s Motorsports Software team analyzes, defines, and delivers next-generation, groundbreaking Motorsports IT software solutions. Using innovative cloud-based infrastructure and modern software development standards, these solutions enable seamless interaction between GM Global Engineering, GM Motorsports, and our race teams—helping accelerate our drivers to the finish line first.

Our combined team partners closely with GM Motorsports Engineering and race teams to ensure podiums and wins for GM’s F1, NASCAR, IndyCar, WEC, and IMSA programs.

This role is part of a new GM Motorsports software team in Ireland, working at the heart of our global race engineering and data ecosystem.

The Role

The software group supporting Motorsports and the Race Vehicle Platform is looking for a Senior Software Developer to join our new Ireland based team.

In this role, you will lead and contribute to the delivery of complex software projects, developing applications using a variety of tools, languages, frameworks, and technologies. You will be working in a high-pace, event-driven environment where reliability, performance, and usability directly impact trackside performance.

This role includes on-call support which will include weekends and shift rotation aligned to the global motorsports calendar and critical track/test events.

In this role, you will lead and contribute to the delivery of complex software projects, developing applications using a variety of tools, languages, frameworks, and technologies. You will be working in a fast pace, event-driven environment where reliability, performance and usability directly impact trackside performance.

Key Responsibilities

Full lifecycle application development using standard frameworks, coding standards, and design patterns
Develop high-quality software applications using sound, repeatable, industry-standard methodologies
Demonstrate proficiency across multiple programming languages, tools, and technologies
Perform performance tuning, profiling, and usability assessment/improvement
Identify and remediate software issues related to code quality, security, patterns/frameworks, and usability
Debug, maintain, and enhance live software systems used in critical motorsports operations
Collaborate with cross-functional partners in Motorsports Engineering, trackside operations, and Global Engineering
Mentor junior software developers and review code to uphold team standards and best practices

Work Schedule & On-Call Expectations

Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical race and test operations
Weekend and shift work required, including early mornings, evenings, and select holidays, aligned to race schedules and key track events
Flexibility to adjust working hours during race weeks and major motorsports events
Ability to support urgent production issues outside standard business hours when needed

Required Qualifications

Minimum 7 years of professional software development experience
Minimum 3 years of experience developing web or Electron applications
Excellent technical knowledge of C#/.NET and React
Strong experience and knowledge of Azure and Azure resources
Solid understanding of software development best practices (code reviews, CI/CD, testing, documentation)
Experience working in an agile/scrum environment
UI design experience and a strong understanding of UX principles
Strong knowledge and understanding of different web platforms and reuse strategies
Proven track record of maintaining and debugging live software systems in production

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience in, or strong passion for, Motorsports and working in a high-pace, event-driven environment
Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering and/or Computer Science
Experience with cloud computing-based distributed systems
Experience supporting mission-critical or real-time applications where uptime and performance are essential

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

PM Group is looking for a Test Automation Engineer to join our team. We are seeking a Test Automation Engineer with proven experience working in a GMP-regulated environment to design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for computerized systems supporting GxP operations. The role partners with software engineering, QA, validation, and business owners to build sustainable automation that accelerates release cycles while preserving full regulatory compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and GAMP 5 expectations

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, and integration) for GxP applications including MES, LIMS, ERP, QMS, and laboratory/manufacturing systems.
Author and execute test scripts within a validated test management ecosystem (e.g., Robot Framework, Tricentis Tosca, TestComplete, Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, UFT) integrated with test management tools (Xray for Jira, Azure DevOps Test Plans, Polarion, Jenkins pipelines).
Produce GxP-compliant test documentation: test plans, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols, test scripts, traceability matrices, defect reports, and summary reports — aligned to GAMP 5 risk-based testing.
Support Computer System Validation (CSV) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) activities, including requirements traceability, risk assessment, and electronic records / electronic signatures (ERES) controls per 21 CFR Part 11.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab) with appropriate change-control gates so automation is itself qualified and version-controlled.
Partner with developers, business analysts, and validation engineers to shift testing left, define acceptance criteria as Gherkin scenarios (Given/When/Then), and ensure data integrity (ALCOA+) is preserved across test environments.
Investigate test failures, perform root-cause analysis, log deviations where required, and support CAPA activities related to test escapes and validation findings.
Maintain test environments, test data (including masked/synthetic GxP data), and reusable automation libraries; champion code reviews and framework standards.
Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA) by presenting automation strategy, evidence, and validation artifacts.

Essential Skills & Experience

Minimum 3–5 years' test automation experience, with at least 2 years in a GMP / GxP-regulated environment (pharma, biotech, medical devices, or CDMO).
Working knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, and data integrity principles (ALCOA+).
Hands-on proficiency with at least one enterprise automation tool (Robot Framework, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium/WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress, TestComplete, or UFT) and one scripting/programming language (Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
Experience automating API tests (REST/SOAP) using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate.
Demonstrable experience with BDD using Gherkin syntax (Given/When/Then) and frameworks such as Cucumber, SpecFlow, Behave, or Robot Framework — including authoring feature files collaboratively with business and validation stakeholders.
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and source control (Git).
Proven track record producing audit-ready validation deliverables (IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability matrices, test summary reports).
Strong understanding of SDLC and V-model / Agile-in-validated-environments delivery.
Excellent written communication — able to author protocols and defect reports that withstand regulatory scrutiny.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience).
Relevant certifications welcomed: ISTQB, Tricentis, GAMP, or Lean Six Sigma.

Key Competencies

Quality and compliance mindset — defaults to documented, traceable work.
Analytical problem-solver with strong attention to detail.
Effective collaborator across IT, QA, validation, and business stakeholders.
Pragmatic — balances regulatory rigor with delivery velocity.

Continuous learner; keeps current with evolving guidance (CSA, AI/ML in GxP).
