jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

Does building systems that help security analysts close a critical incident before it becomes a breach excite you? Does correlating and analyzing data at trillions-of-events-per-day scale sound like the kind of challenge you want to wake up to? Do you care deeply about cybersecurity and want to play an active role in helping organizations defend themselves from sophisticated cyberattacks? We'd love to meet you.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Cloud to join our Threat Detection and Incident Response (TDIR) team, helping revolutionize security management with our AI-native Falcon Next-Gen SIEM platform – enabling customers to detect, investigate, and hunt down threats 150x faster at Petabyte scale.

You'll design, architect, and develop world-class case management and investigation capabilities in Go, empowering security analysts to be more effective at incident response, threat hunting, and collaborative investigations. You'll build intelligent workflows that connect detections, evidence, and response actions into cohesive cases. Leveraging advanced correlation, contextual enrichment, and AI/ML-powered insights, you'll help security teams work smarter through intelligent threat prioritization, automated investigation suggestions, and agentic analyst workflows – helping them respond faster to emerging threats.

While Go experience is preferred, strong backend engineers from other languages who can demonstrate rapid adaptability and a track record of delivering at scale are welcome to apply. If this is the kind of scale and impact you're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do:

Own the engineering bar. Drive architectural improvements, set the standard for code quality, and ensure our systems are performant, reliable, and built to last – not just for today's scale, but for what's next Lead system design and architecture decisions, including design reviews and RFC processes

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Build reliable software with an international product team

Do you enjoy working across backend and frontend development, solving technical challenges and turning business needs into secure, reliable software?

As a Full-Stack Developer at Atea, you will develop and improve business-critical applications using C#/.NET, React and TypeScript. You will join an international product team and work closely with developers, Product Owners and other stakeholders across several European locations.

You will have meaningful technical responsibility, but you will not be expected to solve everything alone. You will have skilled colleagues around you who share knowledge, challenge ideas and work together to build software that creates real value for its users.

About The Role

You will contribute to products within the team’s portfolio, currently including solutions such as Zoom and Cloud Reports. The product scope may develop over time and could also include Application Manager Online.

Regardless of the product you work on, you will be part of the same international team and technical environment. You will contribute throughout the development process, from understanding requirements and discussing technical solutions to development, testing and continuous improvement.

The team works according to Agile principles, with security, maintainability and business value as important parts of the development process.

AI-assisted development is also part of how we work. We are looking for someone who can use AI tools thoughtfully and effectively while maintaining good engineering judgment and high standards for security and quality.

What You Will Do

In this role, you will:

Develop and maintain full-stack features using C#/.NET, APIs, React, TypeScript and JavaScript, based on product and business requirements.
Contribute to architecture and engineering quality by applying secure development principles, established design patterns and SOLID practices, as well as conducting code reviews and writing maintainable unit tests.
Improve the performance, availability and maintainability of our applications through troubleshooting, technical analysis and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with Product Owners, developers and stakeholders across locations, share knowledge within the team and use AI-assisted workflows to support development, testing and problem-solving.

Who We Think Will Thrive In This Role

You will probably enjoy this role if you like combining hands-on development with technical problem-solving and collaboration.

You take responsibility for your work and communicate clearly when requirements, priorities or technical decisions need to be discussed. You care about building solutions that are secure, stable and maintainable, while remaining curious about new technologies and better ways of working.

Because the team is distributed across several countries, you should be comfortable collaborating digitally and communicating with colleagues from different professional and cultural backgrounds.

What We Believe You Need From Day One

We believe the following experience is important for succeeding in the role:

At least four years of professional software development experience
Strong experience with C# and .NET, including API development
Practical experience with React, TypeScript and JavaScript
Experience working with Microsoft SQL databases
Experience with unit testing and writing maintainable tests
A good understanding of secure software development and SOLID principles
Professional English communication skills, both written and spoken, at approximately B2 level or above

Relevant professional experience may compensate for formal IT education.

It is an advantage if you also have

It would be useful, but not essential, if you have experience with:

Microsoft Azure, including Function Apps, Storage, App Service or Key Vault
Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines
Cloud cost awareness and Azure cost optimisation
Mentoring or supporting other developers
Agile product development in an international or distributed team

What You Can Learn After Joining

You do not need to know every product, internal tool or Azure service from your first day.

You will have the opportunity to learn:

The products and business areas supported by the team
The team’s architecture, development processes and internal tools
Additional Azure services relevant to the product portfolio
How the team uses AI-assisted workflows in development, testing and problem-solving

Your curiosity, willingness to share knowledge and ability to learn are more important than being able to check every box.

What You Can Expect From Us

At Atea, you will join an international and welcoming working environment where collaboration and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.

We offer:

A technically varied full-stack role across backend and frontend development
An international product team with skilled colleagues across several European locations
Opportunities to influence technical solutions, architecture and engineering practices
Training and development opportunities tailored to your professional goals
Access to company-sponsored certifications and relevant learning activities
A hybrid working model based on the role, location and business needs
An inclusive environment with professional and social meeting places
Local employment benefits based on whether you are employed in Norway or Latvia

We believe strong software is built by people who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other improve. You will receive responsibility and room to contribute, with a team around you when the problems become difficult.

A Little About Atea

Atea works with technology that supports organisations and the people who depend on it. Behind every reliable solution are people who develop, test, improve and support it together.

As part of Atea, you will join a wider professional community with opportunities to learn, share experience and develop your skills. We believe in giving people responsibility while making sure they have colleagues and expertise around them.

Practical information

Position type: Full-time
Location: Drammen, Norway or Riga, Latvia
Working model: Hybrid
Working language: Norwegian and English
Application deadline: 18.10.26
Contact person: Margarita Scerbakova
Job role: Developer

Interested?

If you would like to build secure and reliable software with an international team, we would be happy to hear from you.

You may not meet every preferred qualification listed above, and that is okay. If you have strong experience with the core technology stack, enjoy collaborative product development and are motivated to learn, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Vi søker en erfaren dataingeniør som vil bygge og drifte dataplattformen bak Placepoint. Du henter inn, modellerer og leverer eiendoms-, selskaps- og kartdata fra Norge og Sverige, sammen med oss to som gjør det i dag, og du bruker AI som et fast verktøy i jobben.

Om oss

Placepoint samler eiendomsinformasjon, eierskap, regulering, transaksjoner og kartdata i én plattform for Norge og Sverige. Over 850 kunder bruker oss, blant dem eiendomsbesittere, utviklere, banker, forsikringsselskaper, meglere og advokater. Vi er over 70 ansatte og holder til i Oslo sentrum.

Dataene er kjernen i det vi leverer. Vi henter dem fra offentlige registre som Matrikkelen, Grunnboken og Enhetsregisteret, fra svenske kilder som Lantmäteriet og Bolagsverket, og fra over 2 300 kartlag. Kundene bruker dem i Placepoint Fusion, Placepoint API og gjennom våre MCP-servere som lar AI-assistenter slå opp i dataene direkte.

Slik jobber vi

AI er en del av hvordan vi utvikler. Hvert repo har instruksjoner for Claude Code og Cursor, mye av koden skrives sammen med en AI-agent, og vi bygger egne MCP-servere så kunder og kolleger kan bruke dataene våre fra Claude og andre assistenter. Vi forventer at du bruker AI mye, og at du er med på å finne ut hvordan vi kan bruke det bedre.

Vi er et lite datateam med bredt ansvar. Den som bygger et dataløp, drifter det også, og vi rydder opp i årsaken når noe feiler.

Dette skal du jobbe med

Utvikle og optimalisere databasene våre i SQL Server og PostGIS: lagrede prosedyrer, datamodeller, indekser, partisjonering og ytelse på store tabeller.
Bygge og drifte dataløp som henter registerdata hver natt og hver uke, med Azure Data Factory, Python-jobber i Azure og dbt.
Følge med på at kjøringene går, finne feilen når de ikke gjør det, og gjøre dem robuste nok til at det skjer sjeldnere.
Modellere og koble norske og svenske registre: eiendom, bygg, adresser, selskaper, roller, eierskap og transaksjoner.
Videreutvikle Placepoint API, MCP-serverne våre og søkeindeksene i Azure AI Search.
Ta inn nye kartlag og datakilder, og holde dem oppdatert.
Levere datasett til kunder og hjelpe kolleger i produkt og salg med data og analyser.

Vi ser etter deg som

har minst seks års relevant arbeidserfaring
har høyere utdanning innen informatikk, geomatikk, matematikk eller lignende, eller tilsvarende arbeidserfaring
er svært god på SQL Server eller PostgreSQL: du skriver effektiv SQL, leser spørringsplaner, lager indekser som holder og modellerer data som skal leve lenge
har bygget og driftet dataløp i produksjon, med Azure Data Factory, Airflow, dbt eller tilsvarende
programmerer godt i Python eller C#, gjerne begge
bruker Claude, Cursor eller lignende AI-verktøy mye i hverdagen, eller er motivert for å gjøre det
snakker og skriver norsk flytende

Det er et pluss om du har erfaring med

PostGIS og geodata: geometri, koordinatsystemer som EUREF89 UTM, GeoJSON, GeoParquet og vektorfliser
norske registre og kartdata: Enhetsregisteret, Matrikkelen, Grunnboken, Aksjonærregisteret og FKB fra Kartverket
svenske registre og data: Lantmäteriet, Bolagsverket og SCB
API-design, MCP-servere og søkemotorer som Azure AI Search eller Elasticsearch
Azure: Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault og Data Lake
Go
3D-data og bygningsmodeller
eiendomsbransjen eller finans

Ingen har alt dette. Vi jobber bredt, og du lærer nye verktøy mens du bruker dem. Det som veier tyngst, er at du lærer fort, bruker AI godt og bryr deg om at dataene er riktige.

Om deg

Du legger merke til når tall ikke stemmer, og graver til du finner årsaken.
Du tar ansvar for det du lager, også etter at det er i drift.
Du jobber selvstendig, deler det du finner og ber om hjelp når det sparer tid.
Du kan forklare et datasett og begrensningene i det til en kollega som ikke er utvikler.
Du trives med å jobbe på kontoret sammen med teamet.

Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät käytännön kehitystyö ja kasvava vastuu teknisestä suunnittelusta.

suunnittelemaan Power Platform- ja Dynamics 365 -ratkaisujen teknisiä toteutuksia

vaikuttamaan siihen, miten ratkaisuja rakennetaan nyt ja tulevaisuudessa
seuraamaan Microsoft-ekosysteemin kehitystä ja tuomaan uusia mahdollisuuksia osaksi asiakasratkaisuja

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla pitkäaikaista kokemusta arkkitehtina. Sen sijaan arvostamme kokemusta ja kiinnostusta tekniseen suunnitteluun.

tekoälytyökalujen hyödyntämisestä omassa työssä

Työssä tarvitset hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Tämä rooli sopii erinomaisesti sinulle, joka haluat kasvaa kohti teknistä arkkitehtuuria kokeneiden ammattilaisten ympäröimänä.

mahdollisuuden rakentaa omaa polkuasi senior developerista kohti teknistä arkkitehtiroolia.
Oppimista tukevan kulttuurin. Sinulle varataan viikoittain aikaa uuden oppimisen ja teknologioihin syventymiseen eli työarjessasi on väljyyttä.
Mentorointia ja tukea kokeneilta arkkitehdeilta ja kehittäjiltä. Myös toimitustiimien ja heimojen kautta osaamista jaetaan työajalla.
Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa roolisi sisältöön ja urapolkuusi.
Erinomaiset työsuhde-edut, kuten kattavat työterveyspalvelut, loma-ajan mökit, 2000 euron rekrytointibonuksen jne.
OpenClub-yhteisöt: leffat, padel, käsityöt, lautapelit, kahvihifistely, viinit, uinti… löydät varmasti omasi!

jobs.title: Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM (frontend/backend udvikler) - genopslag
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Vi håber, at vi gennem din ansøgning kan lære dig at kende og se, hvad du kan bidrage med. Det er fint, hvis du bruger AI-værktøjer til inspiration – men husk at personliggøre din ansøgning, da vi leder efter hele mennesker. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem vores hjemmeside.

Du kan læse mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på: www.clever.dk/velkommen eller vores Instagramkonto @liveticlever. Er du nysgerrig på vores rekrutteringsproces kan du læse mere om den her: Rekrutteringsprocessen i Clever | Clever .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:
A leading role in shaping our holistic organisation‑wide solution architecture
Collaboration with highly skilled IT professionals in a friendly and inclusive culture
Access to the full suite of Microsoft enterprise tools in a modern and tech-driven environment

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices and unite 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is expanding to 26 professionals, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join a team of experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

You shape our digital backbone and architectural direction

We are looking for an Solution Architect, to take the lead in designing, maintaining, and governing the company wide architecture that underpins our global impact. You ensure coherence across platforms, promote future‑ready solutions, and translate business needs into secure, scalable, and well‑governed technologies. Along the way, you will work closely with our subject matter experts, and various business stakeholders.

You will, for example:
Design and maintain the end‑to‑end organisation-wide architecture for our technology stack, which includes Dynamics 365 CE and F&O, Power Platform, Fabric, Copilot and related SaaS systems.
Co-own and enforce best practices for deployment, release management, and technical documentation
Define and create Architecture Principles for our entire technology stack e.g. integration principles and patterns that govern how applications and data interconnect
Drive a forward‑looking technology perspective, monitoring trends and identifying improvements
Drive technology selection to evaluate and assess new applications or technology requests to improve our internal value generation and efficiency.

You bring technical insights and architectural understanding

With your background in architectural areas like, Solution Architecture, application/system architecture, Software Architecture or transferable roles), you understand how to turn technical complexity into structured, long-term solutions.

We imagine that you:
Hold a relevant degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
Have strong experience with solution architecture and how applications and platforms integrate
Understand IT governance, data protection, and compliance
Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders
Desirably have experience from the financial sector

M365
Microsoft Fabric
Microsoft Dataverse
and several fit for purpose SaaS solutions/applications

Ready to build the digital foundation for global impact?

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. jobs.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

AI agents are non-deterministic: the same input can produce different outputs across runs. Designing enterprise automation around them takes a different discipline than deterministic RPA; grounded context, dynamic decision logic, and guardrails instead of fixed, scripted paths.

This is a forward-deployed, customer-facing engineering role. You will work side by side with enterprise and public sector customers to design, build, and harden agentic workflows in their live environments; combining the hands-on coding of a software engineer, the platform depth of a UiPath specialist, and the end-to-end perspective of a solution architect. You will own the question every customer asks before putting an AI agent into production: “How do we know we can trust it?”

What You'll Do At UiPath

Own the end-to-end architecture for UiPath automation and agentic programs at customer sites - agents, RPA workflows, integrations, data, and human-in-the-loop steps - and document the trade-offs behind it.
Design agentic workflows that combine LLM decision-making with tool and function calling, context grounding, and deterministic fallbacks, so behaviour stays predictable where the business needs it to be.
Architect Document Understanding pipelines - extraction, classification, validation - and the Python services that connect them to customer systems.
Choose the right GenAI/ML technique per problem; prompting, retrieval and context grounding, or a trained model in AI Center; and set the guardrails, human checkpoints, and escalation paths before go-live.
Deploy and operationalize AI agents in production customer environments, including APIs, data pipelines, and integration with existing systems.
Act as a trusted technical advisor: translate requirements into architecture and explain design choices, risks, and trade-offs to audiences from engineers to executives.
Set the standards, reusable patterns, and design reviews that govern delivery from discovery to hypercare; mentor developers and keep the architecture something customers can operate themselves.
Feed field findings such as failure patterns, missing capabilities, design gaps; back into the product roadmap and into reusable assets and accelerators.

What You'll Bring To The Team

7+ years of hands-on software development in Python, C#, TypeScript, VB.NET, or comparable languages, with production-quality code and solid CS fundamentals.
4+ years building UiPath automation workflows, with working knowledge of Orchestrator, Document Understanding, Action Apps, AI Center, and Insights.
Command of UiPath design patterns - Robotic Enterprise Framework, Document Understanding Framework, orchestration processes - and the judgment to know when each fits.
Hands-on experience building, deploying, or operating LLM-based agents and agentic workflows (tool/function calling, RAG, multi-step orchestration, LangChain/LangGraph, Model Context Protocol), ideally in production.
Working understanding of prompting, grounding, and hallucination - and the judgment to keep agent behaviour inside acceptable bounds once it is live.
Proven customer-facing track record in a forward-deployed, professional services, implementation, or consulting role: leading technical workshops, managing stakeholders, delivering under real-world constraints.
Technical leadership across globally distributed teams - driving strategy, mentoring engineers, establishing best practices.
Experience designing end-to-end solutions across applications, APIs, and automation platforms, with a deep grasp of the design choices that make a system scalable, reliable, and fast.
Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to present complex architecture and delivery risk to executive stakeholders.
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As the world moves into an agentic future—the UiPath Platform™ enables AI agents, robots, people, and models to work together harmoniously to revolutionize industries and enhance human potential.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Solution Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will blend both technical expertise and business acumen to support the sales process from start to finish. Your primary responsibility will be to identify and understand customer pain points, translating them into tailored, value-driven solutions. Your ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions will be crucial in delivering exceptional results for our customers.

What You'll Do At UiPath

For the client:

Participate in account strategy planning with the Sales team
Work closely with the Sales team to qualify opportunities and prioritize accordingly
Lead end-to-end Presales activities & create strong value propositions
Perform tailored, high-level demos demonstrating business value
Ensure delivery of strong Rfx’s, contextualized demos and powerful PoV’s
Design solutions to fit client needs and environment during the sales process

Build solutions for different industry verticals
Support Marketing initiatives through evangelism activities, including writing blogs, speaking at UiPath events and other industry events
Work closely with Product teams for improvement of functionalities and adding external technologies to the UiPath ecosystem
Engage in product release cycles to promote new releases and provide feedback on the product roadmap

What You'll Bring To The Team

Demonstrable track record in a client-facing Presales/Sales Engineering/Solution Architect position.
Good balance of technical, business and sales skills.
Strong communication, discovery and interpersonal skills with proven experience, building strong internal and external relationships.
Experience in process discovery, process mining, process orchestration, automation solutions and AI technologies like LLMs and agents.

Driven approach with a solution selling mindset.

Fluent in English and German

Degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Experience with AI cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Foundry) and/or conversational AI platforms (e.g., Cognigy).

Did you know that we have received several awards as an employer in recent years?

om onze Software Development League te versterken.

. Met meer dan 400 gepassioneerde IT-professionals
binnen Software Engineering, Infrastructure, QA, PM/PO, Analyse, Data,… maken we elke dag het verschil bij onze klanten. Hierbij focussen we zowel op project sourcing als Teaming projecten bij grote en middelgrote organisaties, verspreid over verschillende sectoren
zoals media, logistiek, overheid, gezondheidszorg en financiën.

FUNCTIEOMSCHRIJVING

Als .NET Fullstack Developer
bij Axxes ben jij een belangrijke schakel in de oplevering van kwalitatieve code. Je denkt dus mee na over het volledige development-proces
, van de keuze van de correcte technologie (backend & frontend) tot het opstellen van coding guidelines
en kwaliteitsstandaarden
waarbij je steeds door de bril van de eindgebruiker kijkt.

Een greep uit je takenpakket:

Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt
toepassingen met .NET Core
en moderne front-end frameworks zoals React, Angular of Vue
.
Je werkt samen in multidisciplinaire teams
en bent betrokken van analyse tot oplevering.
Je vertaalt functionele behoeften naar schaalbare en onderhoudbare technische oplossingen.
Je bewaakt codekwaliteit
via reviews en testing.
Je blijft continu op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in zowel back- als front-end technologie.

JOUW PROFIEL

Zeker solliciteren als je…

Minstens een eerste ervaring hebt met .NET
(.NET Core, Entity Framework, LINQ, etc. zijn je idealiter ook niet onbekend)
Goed overweg kan met C#, .NET Core én minstens één modern front-end framework
(React, Angular, Vue).
Leergierig bent en graag schakelt tussen verschillende technologieën en projecten.
Al een eerste ervaring hebt met cloud native architecturen zoals microservices.

Kennis hebt van Unit, Acceptatie en Integratie Testing
alsook Test Driven Development
Minstens een Bachelor en/of Master op zak hebt in een IT-gerelateerde opleiding
.

AANBOD

Als .NET Fullstack Developer
bij Axxes geniet je niet enkel van een gevarieerde en uitdagende rol maar er wordt ook enorm ingezet op feel good & werknemerstevredenheid
. Niet voor niets dat we de titel van Best Workplace 2025 gewonnen
hebben! Denk aan een fijne sfeer, team-weekends, jaarlijkse Axxes ski-reis, maandelijkse drinks, ...

Deze feelgood gecombineerd met onze cultuur van kennisdeling
maakt dat je steeds kan deelnemen aan workshops en andere initiatieven georganiseerd door jouw collega’s.

Dit alles aangevuld met een competitieve verloning
, een bedrijfswagen (of mogelijkheid tot mobiliteitsbudget!) en een totaalpakket aan extra-legale voordelen! Zaken zoals een FIP-plan
, een uitgebreid opleidingsbudget
, hybride werkbeleid
, netto-onkostenvergoeding, verzekeringen, gsm, -en internetabonnementen, … mogen natuurlijk niet ontbreken.

Heb jij het gevoel dat deze uitdaging voor jou weggelegd is? Aarzel dan niet om te solliciteren en dan ontmoeten we je hopelijk snel op een van onze kantoren in Gent of Antwerpen!

AANBOD PERMANENT

Innovatieve Klantprojecten
: Werk mee aan uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende klanten zoals VRT, TomTom, DPG Media, Accent, Port of Antwerp, Katoen Natie,… waarbij je voortdurend wordt uitgedaagd met de nieuwste technologieën.

: Ervaar groei door individuele coaching van technische experts, die je begeleiden op persoonlijk en professioneel vlak. Aangevuld met een individueel opleidingsbudget dat je kan inzetten voor opleidingen, conferenties in binnen- en buitenland en doorgedreven certificatie.

Kortom, voor ieder wat wils!
Flexibel werken:
Profiteer van een flexibel werkregime met thuiswerkdagen, afgestemd op de behoeften van jou en de klant, voor een optimale work-life balans.
Volledig geoptimaliseerd pakket:
We bieden een competitief salaris met keuze tussen een bedrijfswagen of mobiliteitsbudget, aangevuld met een heel scala aan extralegale voordelen.

.

is er zeker een plekje voor jou.

waar je terechtkan bij vragen.
Je geeft zelf aan hoe vaak en op welke manier je opvolging
wenst, wij zorgen meermaals per jaar voor knowledge sharing
én informele feel good momenten
en tot slot betalen we correct en stipt
.

Excellent communication skills

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

jobs.description:
Het vertrouwen dat je wil. Zonder erom te moeten vragen.

Werken bij Moore, da’s business as unusual.

Als System Engineer
ben je een belangrijke schakel binnen ons sysadmin-team. Je combineert cloudbeheer met klassieke infrastructuurprojecten en helpt mee bouwen aan een veilige, performante en toekomstgerichte IT-omgeving voor onze organisatie.

Wat zijn jouw belangrijkste taken?

Je beheert, optimaliseert en verder ontwikkelt onze Azure-omgeving en Microsoft 365-infrastructuur.
Je bewaakt de performantie, beschikbaarheid, security en kostenefficiëntie van onze cloudomgeving.
Je helpt mee de brug te slaan tussen onze cloud- en on-premises infrastructuur en bewaakt de samenhang tussen beide.
Je neemt ownership over infrastructuurprojecten, van analyse en ontwerp tot implementatie en opvolging.
Je automatiseert beheertaken via PowerShell en andere automatiseringstools om onze IT-omgeving efficiënter en schaalbaarder te maken.
Je analyseert en lost complexe incidenten op binnen onze tweede- en derdelijnsondersteuning.
Je waakt mee over monitoring, patching, security en de algemene stabiliteit van onze systemen.
Je documenteert oplossingen, deelt jouw expertise binnen het team en begeleidt junior collega's in hun verdere ontwikkeling.
Je volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen het Microsoft- en Azure-ecosysteem op en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteringen.

Word jij onze nieuwe companion?

Welke kennis en ervaring verwachten we van jou?

Je hebt ruime ervaring met Azure, Microsoft 365 en cloudinfrastructuur.
Je beschikt over een sterke kennis van Windows Server, Active Directory en netwerkinfrastructuur.
Je hebt ervaring met scripting en automatisering, bij voorkeur in PowerShell. Kennis van Infrastructure as Code, zoals Bicep of Terraform, is een mooie troef.
Je hebt ervaring met hybride cloud- en on-premises omgevingen en begrijpt de uitdagingen die hierbij komen kijken.
Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels. Kennis van het Frans is een plus.
Je denkt op architectuurniveau en houdt rekening met schaalbaarheid, security en kostenefficiëntie.
Je neemt ownership over projecten en brengt deze succesvol van analyse tot implementatie.
Je deelt graag jouw kennis en fungeert als aanspreekpunt en mentor voor minder ervaren collega's.
Je hebt interesse in cloud security, governance en identity management binnen Azure.
Microsoft Azure-certificeringen zijn een sterke troef.
Je volgt evoluties binnen het Microsoft- en Azure-ecosysteem actief op en zet nieuwe inzichten om in concrete verbeteringen.

Waarom kiezen voor Moore?

Dat is kiezen voor: Het vertrouwen dat je wil. Zonder erom te moeten vragen. Werken bij Moore, da’s business as unusual. Bestaat er een standaard pad om je carrière uit te bouwen? Niet bij Moore. Bij ons groei je op je eigen tempo, in de richting die jij kiest. Je krijgt de coaching en de autonomie om impact te maken. Want waarom zou je een standaard System Engineer willen zijn als je bij Moore zoveel méér kan betekenen?
Ondernemen, innoveren en delen zijn onze kernwaarden. Ze vormen de rode draad in alles wat we doen, niet alleen voor onze klanten, maar ook voor onze companions.
Je uitvalsbasis is Antwerpen en Brussel maar door ons uitgebreid kantorennetwerk en onze policy van plaats- en tijdsonafhankelijk werken, behoort thuiswerk (in combinatie met werken in een kantoor in de nabijheid van de woonplaats) tot de mogelijkheden. Zo blijft jouw privéleven ook in balans.
Je ontvangt een competitief loon dat volledig in lijn ligt met jouw ervaring en capaciteiten, aangevuld met heel wat andere interessante voordelen.
Je komt terecht in een team van experten dat aan de beleving van kandidaten en medewerkers werkt, binnen een warme organisatie waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn. En daarom vinden onze medewerkers Moore Belgium een goede werkplek en ‘a Great Place to Work’ ©

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Core Alarm System
jobs.description:
Location Tech Hubs:
Oslo, Norway or Fuengirola, Malaga, Spain

Reports:
Engineering Manager

Role Overview

The new talent will play a critical role in designing and developing backend systems that support IoT devices, leveraging modern DevOps practices. Works with cutting-edge technologies in Azure cloud infrastructure and a microservices architecture, building solutions that protect the lives and homes of our customers.

Team Overview

The team is responsible for the end-to-end mobile experience that allows customers to configure, monitor, and control their alarm system. Their mission is to provide a seamless, secure, and intuitive experience for managing both security and smart home capabilities directly from the app.

Key user journeys include:

Arming and disarming the alarm system, including automation scenarios.
Managing smart door locks, including locking, unlocking, pairing, and removing devices such as Yale Doorman and Danalock.
Enabling and disabling smart plugs, as well as configuring related automation flows.
Managing core system settings, including room names, areas, and overall system organization.

The team owns the customer-facing experience across these journeys, ensuring reliability, ease of use, and a connected smart home ecosystem

Main Responsibilities

Strengthen and support the development team, building software that helps to protect the lives and homes of our customers.
Write clean, scalable code using C# .NET Core.
Write code and develop according to business and user needs.
Evaluate new code for reliable architecture, stability, reusability, performance, automation, security and metrics.
Remain up to date with the terminology, concepts, and best practices for coding.
Write unit and integration tests to cover functionality and reduce regressions.
Mentor junior developers and new team members
Coordinate with product owners, developers and architects.
Solve complex development problems and technical challenges through innovative approaches and problem solving.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in relevant field (Computer Sciences, Information, Computer Engineering)

Requirements

7+ yrs of experience as a hands on Backend Developer
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core knowledge
5+ yrs of experience with microservices and APIs (REST and event-based architectures).
Experience with Claude Code for AI Assisted development and code generation
Experience writing backend services consumed by IOS and Android apps
SQL and Azure Service Bus Knowledge Ability in automation and integration testing.
Excellent verbal and written English skills
A valid work permit in the EU.

Nice-to-have 

Knowledge of Azure ecosystem
DevOps and Terraform experience
Expertise with CI/CD and test automation

DWS Group

Title:
Solution Architect

Madrid

About DWS:

Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.

Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.

We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow.

As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

This is your chance to invest in your future.

Read More About DWS And Who We Are Here.

Team / division overview

In Solution & Data Architecture we focus on shaping architecture relevant patterns and guidelines and support delivery teams implementing their solutions aligned to these standards. We closely work together with Domain Architects, Security SMEs, Data SMEs and Delivery Teams to assure overall strategic and policy adherence of any solution we deliver into the organization. As such the team supports working closely with delivery teams to derive any functional and non-functional requirements and define the overall solution. This includes working with data architects to derive the best data strategy (ingest, transform, consume) as well as building services and applications on top. Solution architects also contribute to the strategic patterns, opinionated decision trees and do research and development with new technologies to help continuously improve the overall architecture and landscape of the organization.

Your Responsibilities

As a Solution Architect you will:

Break down functional and non-functional requirements into individual building blocks, components, ingest pipelines, services and front ends and work closely with data architects to provide an efficient model for managing and consuming data.
Work with and coach / help engineers to implement the suggested designs.
Collaborate with Domain Architects and fellow Solution and Data architect to work out strategic architecture decision records, patterns, or even code to common, recurring problems or to support delivery of individual strategies
Own and drive the overall solution design and help delivery teams to defend these designs before individual design authorities
Assess and R&D new technologies and derive usage patterns for the broader organization to adopt and keeping the technology estate up to date and keep improving the overall architecture in DWS.

We are looking for :

Degree in Computer Science or a related field with a minimum of 5 years of experience in Java / DotNet engineering, and architecture
Prior experience in working in the financial industry or specifically in Asset Management is a big plus
Very good understanding of the Java eco systems, specifically J2EE, Sprint Boot and building services using the latest JDKs.
Good understanding of DotNet, Typescript and Python a plus
Abstract thinking and the ability to break down complex problems into smaller, digestible, implementable pieces.
Experience in TOGAF of SAFe are a plus.
Strategic thinking and planning, laying out common solutions for recurring problems (patterns. opinionated decision trees, design decisions)
Keen to work with new technologies to derive opportunities for enhancing the overall architecture
Good understanding and experience in deploying workloads to the cloud, preferably GCP
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

jobs.title: Global OT Application Engineer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Engineer implements, integrates, tests, deploys and supports industrial applications across manufacturing sites. The role configures and implements global use cases and applications.

The Application Engineer is the technical bridge between plants, application owners, developers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, software vendors and system integrators. The role covers both purchased or configured applications and internally built solutions; it is neither limited to software development nor to coordination.

Assigned scope:

Global OT applications across manufacturing sites, including MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT and CMMS domains.
Purchased, configured and internally developed applications and their interfaces to plant and business systems.

Primary emphasis:

Applications are deployed safely, consistently and with clear acceptance evidence.
Plant systems exchange accurate and reliable data through governed interfaces.
Sites receive effective onboarding, technical support and operational handover.
Incidents and recurring technical problems are resolved at the appropriate support level.
Global templates and standards are applied without losing control of necessary local adaptations.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Implementation and Integration:

Configure and implement applications, templates and technical components in accordance with the approved solution design.
Gather requirements to integrate applications with PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES/MOM, IIoT, historians and business systems such as ERP, LIMS or QMS.
Configure and troubleshoot industrial data exchange using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ensure that global libraries, naming conventions, templates, interfaces and deployment standards are followed.
Document any approved local deviation from the global template, including its justification and approval, in the application documentation.
Review technical and functional deliveries from developers, vendors and system integrators and challenge gaps in quality, maintainability or operability.

Testing and Validation:

Translate approved requirements and designs into a complete and traceable technical test scope.
Prepare and execute functional, integration and regression tests and support FAT, SAT and user acceptance testing.
Diagnose bugs, coordinate correction and test cycles, and maintain clear test evidence and release documentation.
Verify connectivity, data integrity, performance, resilience, security controls and operational readiness.
Confirm that acceptance criteria are met before recommending release or production deployment.

Deployment and Site Onboarding:

Lead the technical work required to take an application from a controlled release into stable plant operation.
Assess site readiness, infrastructure, signals, interfaces, data availability and local dependencies.
Coordinate technical activities with plant stakeholders, local OT teams, vendors and system integrators.
Execute or supervise installation, configuration, commissioning and cut-over activities.
Provide hypercare, technical training, documentation and a clear handover to support and site teams.

Operations and Support:

Provide ITIL-based L2/L3 application support: advanced troubleshooting, functional bug-fixing and technical incident escalation across sites (ITIL support levels, not Purdue Model network layers).
Perform problem management: conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for recurring application errors.
Manage technical change requests: oversee software modifications from assessment through testing, release and production deployment.
Monitor application health: track application performance, data interfaces (APIs) and support trends to recommend continuous improvements.
Maintain knowledge databases: manage technical documentation, application runbooks, release notes and Known-Error Databases (KEDB).

Plant and Technical Team Interface:

Act as the practical interface between plant operations and the teams that design, build and supply the applications.
Translate plant constraints and operational issues into actionable technical requirements and bugs.
Explain technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions to plant and business stakeholders.
Coordinate effectively with the Application Owner on priorities, scope, standards and acceptance.
Work with developers on build activities and with delivery leads or Scrum Masters on planning and execution.
Challenge vendors and system integrators on technical quality, delivery evidence and issue resolution, escalating commercial or roadmap matters to the Application Owner.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Strong knowledge of at least one relevant application domain: MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or CMMS, and of interfaces to PLC, SCADA and DCS systems.
Practical integration knowledge using OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ability to read, adapt or create components using Python, C#, Java or JavaScript when needed.
Working knowledge of versioning, release, incident, problem and change-management practices.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 principles, OT cybersecurity and regulated validation requirements where applicable.

Behavioral Competencies:

Plant-oriented, pragmatic and structured, with strong ownership of technical issues.
Constructive challenge of delivery evidence from developers, vendors and system integrators.
Clear cross-functional communication across plant, specialist and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in automation, electrical, software or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience with industrial applications, automation, MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or comparable manufacturing systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated responsibility across multiple sites or complex industrial programs.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany, plus a senior regional position in the north-eastern United States.
Home-based or hybrid working with regular domestic and international travel to manufacturing sites.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Application Engineer:

Together with the Project Managers, defines implementation and configuration approaches within approved standards.
Stops or rejects a technical deployment when readiness or acceptance criteria are not met.
Recommends fixes, improvements and standard changes based on operational evidence.
Escalates architecture, security, scope and vendor-performance risks.
The role does not own application strategy, roadmap, backlog or commercial vendor decisions, does not act only as a software developer without integration, testing, support and site responsibilities, does not replace the plant's operational ownership or bypass agreed OT governance, and does not approve material deviations from global standards without the relevant owner or authority.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: priorities, scope, standards, acceptance and escalation of commercial or roadmap matters.
Plant operations and local OT teams: site readiness, deployment activities, onboarding, training, support and operational handover.
Developers, delivery leads and Scrum Masters: build activities, defect resolution, planning and release execution.
Infrastructure and cybersecurity teams: interfaces, security controls, architecture dependencies and technical risk.
Software vendors and system integrators: technical quality, delivery evidence, testing and issue resolution.
Business and functional stakeholders (production, quality, maintenance, supply chain): technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions affecting plant operations.
Project managers: rollout planning and execution; sequencing, dependencies and escalation of deviations.

How You’ll Have Impact

Build the Platform Behind the Platform: Design and evolve the cloud infrastructure that powers our multi-tenant SaaS ecosystem.
Enable Engineering Velocity: Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.
Drive Reliability & Observability: Ensure high availability, performance, and real-time visibility across distributed systems.
Architect for Scale: Design infrastructure that supports growth, AI workloads, and distributed services.
Champion Infrastructure as Code: Everything reproducible, versioned, and automated.
Embed Security by Design: Implement DevSecOps best practices across the delivery lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure.
Manage and optimize containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or equivalent).
Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.
Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (ELK stack, Grafana dashboards and alerting, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools).
Operate, monitor, and tune Microsoft SQL Server databases (performance, backups, high availability).
Optimize system performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate closely with backend engineers (Java / Kotlin, C#, Node.js) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.
Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
Leverage AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Codex, automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.
Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.

You don’t just maintain infrastructure — you engineer the reliability of the business.

Cloud Building Blocks: AWS & Azure

We run workloads on both AWS and Azure. We are looking for solid hands-on experience with IaaS and core managed cloud services on at least one of them — knowing the equivalent on the other cloud is a strong plus. These are the building blocks you’ll work with:

Virtual machines & autoscaling — Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets | AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups
Virtual networking — Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints | AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink
L7 load balancing + WAF — Azure: Application Gateway + WAF | AWS: Application Load Balancer + AWS WAF
Web app / API hosting — Azure: App Service | AWS: Elastic Beanstalk / App Runner
Managed Kubernetes — Azure: AKS | AWS: EKS
Message queues — Azure: Azure Storage — Queues | AWS: Amazon SQS
Object storage — Azure: Azure Storage — Blobs | AWS: Amazon S3
In-memory cache — Azure: Azure Cache for Redis | AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)
Managed SQL Server — Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance | AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server
Workload identity (secretless auth) — Azure: Managed Identity + DefaultAzureCredential | AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) + SDK default credential chain
Secrets & keys — Azure: Key Vault | AWS: AWS Secrets Manager / KMS
Transactional email — Azure: Azure Communication Services (Email) | AWS: Amazon SES
Per-environment configuration — Azure: App Settings | AWS: Systems Manager Parameter Store / AppConfig
Logs, metrics & alerts — Azure: Log Analytics / Azure Monitor | AWS: Amazon CloudWatch
Runtime diagnostics — Azure: Kudu / App Service diagnostics | AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights / SSM Session Manager

Requisitos

5+ years of experience in DevOps / Cloud Engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with AWS or Azure — experience with both is a strong plus.
Deep understanding of containerization and distributed systems, with production experience in Kubernetes (required).
Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or similar).
Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server (administration, performance tuning, backup/restore, high availability).
Experience with Redis in production (caching, session storage, pub/sub).
Strong knowledge of networking, security, and system architecture.
Experience working in high-availability SaaS environments.
Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and incident management, including Grafana dashboards and alerting.
Automation-first mindset.
Experience collaborating with backend engineering teams.
Languages: fluent Spanish and professional English (both required).

We don’t expect you to master every tool listed above, but we do expect solid hands-on experience with at least one technology in each area: cloud provider (AWS / Azure), containers & orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and databases & caching.

Nice-to-Have Superpowers

Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements.
Experience with cost optimization strategies in cloud environments.
Knowledge of GitOps workflows.
Experience in multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure.

French — a huge plus (we can dream!).

Our Benefits

Private supplementary health insurance including coverage for your immediate family, offering peace of mind beyond the public system.
Meal allowance to support your daily work routines.
Additional paid days off (24 December & Carnival Day) on top of statutory annual leave - giving you more time for what matters.
Hybrid working model with a mix of remote and office days to support flexibility and modern ways of working.
Intercultural collaboration & cross border projects - grow your international experience by working with colleagues in Germany.
Modern technology and continuous development opportunities to support your growth and keep you up to date in your field.
Bright, appealing offices in a trendy Lisbon area, designed for productive and enjoyable workdays.

Your tasks

Collaborate in an agile team with Product Owners, Project Managers, Solution Architects and Developers to deliver business-focused solutions.
Analyze requirements and design solutions aligned with business goals, including customizations in Dynamics 365 (entities, forms, workflows, business rules).
Develop and maintain applications using C# / .NET, JavaScript / TypeScript, Power Platform and optimize integrations via REST APIs, Azure Functions and Service Bus.
Implement automation and CI/CD pipelines following DevOps best practices, while monitoring and improving performance with Azure tools like Application Insights.
Refactor and enhance existing applications to meet the latest standards and ensure long-term maintainability.

Your profile

Over 3 years of hands-on experience developing solutions with Power Platform, Dynamics 365 Sales or Customer Insights, using modern frameworks and best practices.
Strong technical expertise in C# / .NET and JavaScript / TypeScript, combined with practical customization of Dynamics 365 (entities, forms, workflows, business rules).

Proficient in DevOps practices, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation, ensuring smooth and reliable deployments.
Experienced in solution design and requirements analysis, applying design patterns, security principles and software development best practices.

You will enjoy working in our team if you are a collaborative and proactive team player, with strong problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and a high sense of responsibility and independence. Excellent English skills (C1) are mandatory, Portuguese and/or German language skills are a plus.

Our mission is to support the energy revolution with IT knowledge, intelligent solutions and the understanding that digitalization is the main drive for innovation. Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, "Enrich connections. For good.", these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.
In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.
Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

The Role

Edenred is a global leader in payment solutions, offering innovative and efficient services that enhance the daily lives of individuals and businesses. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are seeking a talented Level 2 .Net Backend Developer to join our dynamic team.

Responsibilities:

Assist in designing and developing software solutions under guidance.
Work with the team to implement experiments and learn from data-driven insights.
Write clean and maintainable code with support from peers and mentors.
Seek opportunities to learn from more experienced developers.
Participate in code reviews to learn coding standards and improve code quality.
Follow and adopt best practices in software development.
Contribute to discussions about architecture and design within the team.
Embrace a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement by sharing ideas and feedback.

Your Profile:

As a .Net Backend Developer working in a multidisciplinary squad
, you will contribute directly to the company wide objectives with your involvement across different team layers.
3-6 Years experience in .Net Development
At the squad layer, you will work with your product, data, and design counterparts and other stakeholders to discover, ideate, conduct experiments, and solve customer problems.
At the chapter layer, you will contribute to the backend chapter by supporting its goals and initiatives. You will help with key tasks and collaborate with others to grow your skills while learning from more experienced team members.

Technical Qualifications:

Experience in C# and .NET (Core, NET 6+)
Understanding of RESTful APIs, including designing and consuming APIs for integration between systems.
Knowledge of Entity Framework and SQL, including database design and queries.
Understanding of basic software development methodologies and coding best practices.
Interest or beginner experience in working with hosting and cloud services.
Exposure to .NET testing libraries like XUnit, NSubstitute.
Familiarity with event-driven architectures, microservices, or distributed systems is a plus.

*This is a fully remote role*

Experience Required: 8+ Years (including 4+ years on Mendix)
Platform: Mendix low-code (web and native mobile), hosted on Microsoft Azure; integration through an enterprise service bus (webMethods)
Focus: Technical leadership across web, native mobile, integration and DevOps; complex workflows, business rules and integrations
Location: Onsite at the Client location in Dubai, UAE

Note: Immediate joiners preferred

Project Description
We're building a delivery team for a large, multi-phase enterprise Mendix programme and are looking for a Senior Mendix Developer to lead the technical build as a key member of the team.

Role summary
We are looking for a Senior Mendix Developer to act as Technical Lead for a large, multi-phase enterprise Mendix programme, building the most complex processes and integrations and leading a hybrid onsite/offsite team of Mendix, mobile, integration and DevOps engineers.

Key responsibilities
- Lead the day-to-day technical build and act as the technical point of contact for the development, mobile, integration and DevOps team.
- Take over an existing Mendix application built by another team and extend it rather than rebuild it.
- Build the most complex processes, including multi-step approval workflows with send-back, SLA timers and escalation, calculation and rules engines, and financial postings.
- Guide the build of shared components: request handling, configurable rules, notifications, document generation, schedulers, reports and KPI dashboards.
- Guide the Mendix native mobile build (iOS and Android), including offline drafts, secure storage, biometric login, push notifications and in-app payments.
- Lead the Mendix side of all integrations with the Integration Developer: REST/SOAP contracts, error handling, retries, idempotency, exception queues and reconciliation.
- Integrate with document management, digital identity and e-signature, payment gateway, finance/ERP, banking, CRM and government systems through the ESB.
- Work with the DevOps Engineer on CI/CD for Mendix web and native mobile builds, environment promotion and releases in waves.
- Set development standards, run code reviews, estimate work and track progress through each wave and tollgate.
- Support SIT, performance and security testing, UAT, go-live and hypercare.
- Mentor developers onsite and offsite, and hand over documentation to the client's support team.

Key requirements
- Mendix Advanced certification (state certificate ID).
- 4+ years of hands-on Mendix: workflows, microflows, nanoflows, domain modelling, security and performance tuning.
- REST (JSON) and SOAP (XML) integration in Mendix, including published REST/OData services and import/export mappings.
- API authentication (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, API keys, certificates) and integration through an ESB / middleware layer.
- Reliable integration patterns: error handling, retries, idempotency, callbacks / webhooks, batch / file exchange, logging and reconciliation.
- Mendix native mobile (iOS and Android): offline-first design, device features and mobile security (working knowledge or better).
- Microsoft Azure, Git, and CI/CD for Mendix web and native mobile builds (working knowledge or better).
- Arabic / English multilingual applications with full RTL.
- Experience leading or mentoring a development team.

Advantage
- Mendix Expert certification.
- webMethods or a similar ESB (e.g. MuleSoft, TIBCO, Azure Integration Services).
- IBM FileNet or other enterprise document management integration.
- UAE Pass or other national digital identity and e-signature integration.
- Payment gateway integration (card, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay).
- Government or regulated-sector delivery.
- Financial, endowment, asset or case-management systems.
- Arabic language skills.
- Experience working in the Middle East.

jobs.title: Solutions & Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Solutions & Platform Engineer
Fully remote Full-time contract (40 hours per week) Start as soon as possible

The role
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Solutions & Platform Engineer to develop, maintain and improve our applications and digital platforms.
You will translate business and functional requirements into practical technical designs and reliable software. You will take responsibility for technical delivery on agreed priorities, combining new development with day-to-day engineering across existing systems.

Your responsibilities
Technical design: Translate agreed functional requirements into system architecture, data models and implementation plans.

Implementation: Develop and extend software across the following areas:Application functionality: Build user interfaces and implement defined application logic.
AI components: Integrate language models into application features.
Data pipelines: Build data collection and processing pipelines, including web scraping.
System integrations: Integrate applications with enterprise platforms and external business systems.
Task automation: Automate recurring and multi-step tasks through scheduling and orchestration.

Testing: Write and maintain automated tests to verify functionality and catch regressions.
Deployment: Configure cloud environments and deploy application releases.
Maintenance: Diagnose and resolve production issues, and maintain application code, dependencies and cloud infrastructure.

What you bring
Backend development: Strong Python skills and experience building well-structured APIs and services, ideally with FastAPI. Experience implementing external integrations, background tasks and data validation.
Frontend development: Experience with a modern frontend framework, preferably React and TypeScript, covering reusable components, state management, API integration and responsive interfaces.
Architecture and data: The ability to translate functional requirements into pragmatic system designs and relational data models. Strong SQL skills and the ability to extend existing systems without unnecessary complexity.
Applied AI: Practical experience integrating LLMs into applications, using techniques such as retrieval, structured outputs and evaluation. The ability to work across different providers, models and APIs, balancing reliability, latency and cost. Experience with agentic workflows, including tool use and multi-step task orchestration, is a plus.
Data acquisition: Experience collecting data through APIs, web scraping or automated workflows, and turning inconsistent inputs into dependable application data.
Cloud and operations: Experience deploying and supporting containerized applications in Azure or a comparable cloud environment, including configuration, authentication, secrets management, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
Engineering quality: A disciplined approach to testing, version control, documentation and secure, maintainable code, with the ability to investigate and resolve problems across the stack.

Our technology
Our core application stack includes Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, SQL Server and Azure. Our environment also includes Microsoft Graph and SharePoint integrations and a React Native mobile application. Experience with every technology is not required; depth in the core technologies and the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of a working system matter more.

How you work
You plan and prioritize your work independently and see agreed work through to completion.
You communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs clearly, and seek clarification early when business or domain requirements are unclear.
You have strong written and spoken English and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You will help shape architecture and engineering practices, collaborate directly with users, and build and improve applications that support public institutions and responsible AI adoption.

Working hours
Flexible, with a preference for 4–6 of your daily working hours to fall between 08:00 and 22:00 Abu Dhabi time (UTC+4). The exact schedule will be agreed together.

For additional information on Regxelerator, visit regxelerator.com.
