Om rollen

Det här är en renodlad programmeringsroll. Du kommer att jobba i kärnan av plattformens kodbas: arkitektur, rendering, UI och prestanda. Stora mängder geologisk data och 3D-modeller ska laddas snabbt, renderas snyggt och gå att navigera flytande i realtid. Det är den typen av problem du kommer att lösa. Du jobbar nära våra 3D-artister och resten av teamet, men din del är koden.

Vad du kommer att göra

Utveckla nya funktioner i plattformen i Unity och C#, från design av lösningen till färdig, testad kod
Bygga och vidareutveckla plattformens gränssnitt i UI Toolkit
Profilera och optimera rendering, minne och laddtider så att stora datamängder flyter i realtid
Skriva shaders och renderingskod som gör geologisk data tydlig och visuellt övertygande
Bidra till våra interna verktyg och datapipelines (Unity Editor, Blender, databaser, GIS) som gör det snabbare att få in kunddata i plattformen

Vi söker dig som

Har minst tre års arbetslivserfarenhet som programmerare. Bakgrund som spelprogrammerare fungerar bra, bakgrund som system- eller grafikprogrammerare är ännu bättre.
Kan Unity och C# på djupet, det är kärnan i allt vi bygger
Har jobbat med UI Toolkit
Är van att profilera och optimera Unity-applikationer
Skriver shaders. Shader Graph är okej, HLSL eller motsvarande är bättre.
Talar och skriver svenska
Bor i Göteborg eller är redo att flytta hit. Rollen är på plats på kontoret.

Meriterande

God engelska i tal och skrift, eftersom våra kunder är internationella
Webbutveckling och Python
Utveckling för mobila plattformar
Import och hantering av databaser
Egenutvecklade verktyg för Unity Editor
Egenutvecklade verktyg för Blender
GIS

Placering: Göteborg, på plats
Omfattning: Heltid
Start: Enligt överenskommelse
Du behöver ha rätt att arbeta i Sverige

Vi intervjuar löpande till den här tjänsten, så skicka in din ansökan direkt. Skicka CV, personligt brev och länk till portfolio eller GitHub till jobs@terrahutton.io med ämnesraden "Unityprogrammerare - Göteborg".

GM’s Motorsports Software team analyzes, defines, and delivers next-generation, groundbreaking Motorsports IT software solutions. Using innovative cloud-based infrastructure and modern software development standards, these solutions enable seamless interaction between GM Global Engineering, GM Motorsports, and our race teams—helping accelerate our drivers to the finish line first.

In this role, you will lead and contribute to the delivery of complex software projects, developing applications using a variety of tools, languages, frameworks, and technologies. Minimum 3 years of experience developing web or Electron applications
Excellent technical knowledge of C#/.NET and React

Experience working in an agile/scrum environment

Proven track record of maintaining and debugging live software systems in production

new_jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Overview

PM Group is looking for a Test Automation Engineer to join our team. We are seeking a Test Automation Engineer with proven experience working in a GMP-regulated environment to design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for computerized systems supporting GxP operations. The role partners with software engineering, QA, validation, and business owners to build sustainable automation that accelerates release cycles while preserving full regulatory compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and GAMP 5 expectations

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, and integration) for GxP applications including MES, LIMS, ERP, QMS, and laboratory/manufacturing systems.
Author and execute test scripts within a validated test management ecosystem (e.g., Robot Framework, Tricentis Tosca, TestComplete, Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, UFT) integrated with test management tools (Xray for Jira, Azure DevOps Test Plans, Polarion, Jenkins pipelines).
Produce GxP-compliant test documentation: test plans, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols, test scripts, traceability matrices, defect reports, and summary reports — aligned to GAMP 5 risk-based testing.
Support Computer System Validation (CSV) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) activities, including requirements traceability, risk assessment, and electronic records / electronic signatures (ERES) controls per 21 CFR Part 11.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab) with appropriate change-control gates so automation is itself qualified and version-controlled.
Partner with developers, business analysts, and validation engineers to shift testing left, define acceptance criteria as Gherkin scenarios (Given/When/Then), and ensure data integrity (ALCOA+) is preserved across test environments.
Investigate test failures, perform root-cause analysis, log deviations where required, and support CAPA activities related to test escapes and validation findings.
Maintain test environments, test data (including masked/synthetic GxP data), and reusable automation libraries; champion code reviews and framework standards.
Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA) by presenting automation strategy, evidence, and validation artifacts.

Essential Skills & Experience

Minimum 3–5 years' test automation experience, with at least 2 years in a GMP / GxP-regulated environment (pharma, biotech, medical devices, or CDMO).
Working knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, and data integrity principles (ALCOA+).
Hands-on proficiency with at least one enterprise automation tool (Robot Framework, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium/WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress, TestComplete, or UFT) and one scripting/programming language (Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
Experience automating API tests (REST/SOAP) using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate.
Demonstrable experience with BDD using Gherkin syntax (Given/When/Then) and frameworks such as Cucumber, SpecFlow, Behave, or Robot Framework — including authoring feature files collaboratively with business and validation stakeholders.
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and source control (Git).
Proven track record producing audit-ready validation deliverables (IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability matrices, test summary reports).
Strong understanding of SDLC and V-model / Agile-in-validated-environments delivery.
Excellent written communication — able to author protocols and defect reports that withstand regulatory scrutiny.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience).
Relevant certifications welcomed: ISTQB, Tricentis, GAMP, or Lean Six Sigma.

Key Competencies

Quality and compliance mindset — defaults to documented, traceable work.
Analytical problem-solver with strong attention to detail.
Effective collaborator across IT, QA, validation, and business stakeholders.
Pragmatic — balances regulatory rigor with delivery velocity.

Continuous learner; keeps current with evolving guidance (CSA, AI/ML in GxP).

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

Does building systems that help security analysts close a critical incident before it becomes a breach excite you? Does correlating and analyzing data at trillions-of-events-per-day scale sound like the kind of challenge you want to wake up to? Do you care deeply about cybersecurity and want to play an active role in helping organizations defend themselves from sophisticated cyberattacks? We'd love to meet you.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Cloud to join our Threat Detection and Incident Response (TDIR) team, helping revolutionize security management with our AI-native Falcon Next-Gen SIEM platform – enabling customers to detect, investigate, and hunt down threats 150x faster at Petabyte scale.

You'll design, architect, and develop world-class case management and investigation capabilities in Go, empowering security analysts to be more effective at incident response, threat hunting, and collaborative investigations. You'll build intelligent workflows that connect detections, evidence, and response actions into cohesive cases. Leveraging advanced correlation, contextual enrichment, and AI/ML-powered insights, you'll help security teams work smarter through intelligent threat prioritization, automated investigation suggestions, and agentic analyst workflows – helping them respond faster to emerging threats.

Build reliable software with an international product team

Do you enjoy working across backend and frontend development, solving technical challenges and turning business needs into secure, reliable software?

As a Full-Stack Developer at Atea, you will develop and improve business-critical applications using C#/.NET, React and TypeScript. You will join an international product team and work closely with developers, Product Owners and other stakeholders across several European locations.

You will have meaningful technical responsibility, but you will not be expected to solve everything alone. You will have skilled colleagues around you who share knowledge, challenge ideas and work together to build software that creates real value for its users.

About The Role

You will contribute to products within the team’s portfolio, currently including solutions such as Zoom and Cloud Reports. The product scope may develop over time and could also include Application Manager Online.

Regardless of the product you work on, you will be part of the same international team and technical environment. You will contribute throughout the development process, from understanding requirements and discussing technical solutions to development, testing and continuous improvement.

The team works according to Agile principles, with security, maintainability and business value as important parts of the development process.

AI-assisted development is also part of how we work. We are looking for someone who can use AI tools thoughtfully and effectively while maintaining good engineering judgment and high standards for security and quality.

What You Will Do

In this role, you will:

Develop and maintain full-stack features using C#/.NET, APIs, React, TypeScript and JavaScript, based on product and business requirements.
Contribute to architecture and engineering quality by applying secure development principles, established design patterns and SOLID practices, as well as conducting code reviews and writing maintainable unit tests.
Improve the performance, availability and maintainability of our applications through troubleshooting, technical analysis and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with Product Owners, developers and stakeholders across locations, share knowledge within the team and use AI-assisted workflows to support development, testing and problem-solving.

Who We Think Will Thrive In This Role

You will probably enjoy this role if you like combining hands-on development with technical problem-solving and collaboration.

You take responsibility for your work and communicate clearly when requirements, priorities or technical decisions need to be discussed. You care about building solutions that are secure, stable and maintainable, while remaining curious about new technologies and better ways of working.

Because the team is distributed across several countries, you should be comfortable collaborating digitally and communicating with colleagues from different professional and cultural backgrounds.

What We Believe You Need From Day One

We believe the following experience is important for succeeding in the role:

At least four years of professional software development experience
Strong experience with C# and .NET, including API development
Practical experience with React, TypeScript and JavaScript
Experience working with Microsoft SQL databases
Experience with unit testing and writing maintainable tests
A good understanding of secure software development and SOLID principles
Professional English communication skills, both written and spoken, at approximately B2 level or above

Relevant professional experience may compensate for formal IT education.

It is an advantage if you also have

It would be useful, but not essential, if you have experience with:

Microsoft Azure, including Function Apps, Storage, App Service or Key Vault
Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines
Cloud cost awareness and Azure cost optimisation
Mentoring or supporting other developers
Agile product development in an international or distributed team

What You Can Learn After Joining

You do not need to know every product, internal tool or Azure service from your first day.

You will have the opportunity to learn:

The products and business areas supported by the team
The team’s architecture, development processes and internal tools
Additional Azure services relevant to the product portfolio
How the team uses AI-assisted workflows in development, testing and problem-solving

new_jobs.title: Senior Aspen MES Programmer
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Aspen MES Programmer with 15+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting AspenTech Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions in regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environments. This is a senior technical and advisory role for an individual who has led complex MES implementations end-to-end, mentored junior engineers, and served as the go-to subject matter expert for Aspen MES architecture, integration, and validation strategy. The successful candidate will combine deep technical mastery of Aspen InfoPlus.21 and the AspenTech MES/MOM suite with strong leadership skills, acting as a technical lead on multi-site programs, greenfield implementations, and enterprise-level system upgrades, while ensuring full compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and data integrity requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Serve as the senior technical authority and architect for Aspen MES / Aspen InfoPlus.21 (IP.21) solutions across one or more manufacturing sites, defining system architecture, standards, and best practices.
Lead the design and configuration of complex electronic batch records (EBRs), recipe management structures, equipment models, and unit procedures for high-complexity or multi-product manufacturing lines.
Own the technical roadmap for MES platform evolution, including upgrade strategy, capacity planning, and long-term architecture decisions across the Aspen MOM/MES suite (Aspen MES, Aspen PEM, Aspen Enterprise Historian).
Evaluate emerging AspenTech capabilities and industry trends (Industry 4.0, MES/MOM convergence, cloud-enabled historians) and advise leadership on adoption strategy.

Development, Integration & Delivery

Lead full lifecycle delivery of large-scale MES projects: requirements definition, functional/technical design, configuration, custom scripting, integration, testing, validation, and go-live support.
Architect and oversee complex integrations between Aspen MES and DCS/SCADA/PLC systems (e.g., DeltaV, PCS7), ERP platforms (SAP, including SAP MII/PI-PO), LIMS, warehouse management, and serialization/track-and-trace systems.
Design and review advanced scripts, calculations, and custom reports using Aspen MES scripting tools, SQL, and supporting languages (VB.NET, C#, Python) to extend platform capability.
Direct and review the work of junior and mid-level MES programmers/engineers, providing technical mentorship, code/configuration review, and knowledge transfer.
Lead root-cause analysis and resolution for the most complex, cross-system production issues and data integrity discrepancies, minimizing manufacturing downtime.

Quality, Compliance & Validation

Own and drive computer system validation (CSV) strategy for MES projects in accordance with GAMP 5, authoring and approving URS, FS, DS, and IQ/OQ/PQ documentation.
Ensure all MES architecture, configuration, and development activities comply with 21 CFR Part 11, GMP, and data integrity (ALCOA+) principles.
Serve as the senior MES representative in audits, regulatory inspections, and internal quality reviews, providing technical justification and remediation plans as needed.

new_jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Staff

This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity

About The Affiliated Organization

Founded in 1980, Ashoka pioneered the field of social entrepreneurship. We are now the largest association of leading social entrepreneurs in the world, a network of 4000+ Ashoka Fellows in 99 countries at work creating systemic change on the most pressing social and environmental issues of our time. We find, support and collaborate with our Fellows to help scale their solutions across nations and continents and work with a wide range of partners to create an "Everyone a Changemaker" world, one in which we all can find and develop our power to create meaningful change for the good of all.

We are calling these members Ashoka Professional Support Partners (PSPs) rather than "volunteers" to reflect the expertise and commitment to impact they will bring to our global community.

As an Ashoka Support Partner your expertise will be promoted to Fellows over the course of two to three months. If there is a need that meets your interests and availability, an introduction will be made so that you can learn more details about the support partnership and ways that you can contribute. Until that time your name and contact details will be held confidentially to protect your privacy.

Website security and vulnerability management
Backup and disaster recovery planning
Cloud platform management
AI-ready content architecture (good to have!)

Some of the CRM and Constituent systems fellows may need would be:

Salesforce
Microsoft Dynamics
HubSpot
Donor management systems
Constituent relationship managemen

Beyond the website itself, fellows would probably need support in the following technology areas:

Marketing Technology Stack ( Email marketing, campaigns, marketing automation etc)
Global reach (internationalization, localization, translation management, right to left language support)
Performance Engineering (Core Web Vitals, CDN strategies etc)
Mobile performance (this could actually be very crucial for fellows in emerging markets where most of their marketing will happen on Mobile platforms)
Platform Governance and Strategy (editorial permissions architecture, platform sustainability etc)

To summarize what is added above, it could help to have the following:

Experience with modern web architecture, security, performance optimization, AI-ready content systems, structured data, and advanced SEO/discoverability practices.
Demonstrated expertise in website security, accessibility, multilingual implementations, cloud hosting environments, and scalable content management architectures.
Build or rebuild Fellow and Fellow-led organizations' websites — from strategy and information architecture through design, development, and launch — so Fellows can credibly tell their story, recruit supporters, and raise funds online.

Modernize and maintain existing sites — auditing, migrating, and upgrading legacy platforms applying rigor to Fellows' sites.
Integrate essential nonprofit tooling — connecting sites to CRM/donor systems, email platforms, payment/donation processors, analytics, and multilingual/localization support for Fellows working across regions.
Coach and build Fellow capacity — transferring skills to Fellows and their teams so they can update content, run campaigns, and sustain their digital presence independently rather than depending on outside help indefinitely.

Please let us know today if you'd like to join this small but mighty team! You will be deeply appreciated and never taken for granted!

Volunteer Logistics

Estimated hours required per week: 5-10

The estimated duration of the project is: 1-3 months

This position is Virtual (Remote)

Language Requirements

English, other Languages a big plus

Desired Skills And Experience

8+ years of progressively responsible web design, development and tech solutions experience, including at least 3 years in a senior or lead role (leading builds, mentoring, or owning architecture decisions).
A demonstrated portfolio of live websites spanning design through deployment, ideally including nonprofit, multilingual, or multi-site/multi-region projects.
Proven experience working remotely in distributed, cross-cultural teams.
Strong command of user-centered design, information architecture, and visual/brand design principles.
Proficiency in design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) and prototyping.

Back-end and CMS fluency — especially Drupal and/or WordPress, with experience in theming, custom modules, and migrations.
Experience integrating third-party systems (Salesforce/CRM, donation platforms, email tools) and working with APIs.
Familiarity with cloud hosting and DevOps basics and basic SEO/analytics setup.
Literacy in social entrepreneurship and systems-change work, so digital solutions serve mission and scale rather than just looking polished.
Experience with budget-conscious, resource-light environments typical of early-stage Fellow organizations.

Binnen Axxes zijn we momenteel op zoek naar een enthousiaste .NET Fullstack Developer
om onze Software Development League te versterken.

Bij Axxes geloven we in de kracht van innovatie en technologie. Als toonaangevend IT-consultancy bedrijf ondersteunen wij bedrijven bij het bedenken, bouwen en onderhouden van bedrijfskritische digitale oplossingen
. Met meer dan 400 gepassioneerde IT-professionals
binnen Software Engineering, Infrastructure, QA, PM/PO, Analyse, Data,… maken we elke dag het verschil bij onze klanten. Hierbij focussen we zowel op project sourcing als Teaming projecten bij grote en middelgrote organisaties, verspreid over verschillende sectoren
zoals media, logistiek, overheid, gezondheidszorg en financiën.

FUNCTIEOMSCHRIJVING

Als .NET Fullstack Developer
bij Axxes ben jij een belangrijke schakel in de oplevering van kwalitatieve code. Je denkt dus mee na over het volledige development-proces
, van de keuze van de correcte technologie (backend & frontend) tot het opstellen van coding guidelines
en kwaliteitsstandaarden
waarbij je steeds door de bril van de eindgebruiker kijkt.

Een greep uit je takenpakket:

Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt
toepassingen met .NET Core
en moderne front-end frameworks zoals React, Angular of Vue
.
Je werkt samen in multidisciplinaire teams
en bent betrokken van analyse tot oplevering.
Je vertaalt functionele behoeften naar schaalbare en onderhoudbare technische oplossingen.
Je bewaakt codekwaliteit
via reviews en testing.
Je blijft continu op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in zowel back- als front-end technologie.

JOUW PROFIEL

Zeker solliciteren als je…

Minstens een eerste ervaring hebt met .NET
(.NET Core, Entity Framework, LINQ, etc. zijn je idealiter ook niet onbekend)
Goed overweg kan met C#, .NET Core én minstens één modern front-end framework
(React, Angular, Vue).
Leergierig bent en graag schakelt tussen verschillende technologieën en projecten.
Al een eerste ervaring hebt met cloud native architecturen zoals microservices.

Kennis hebt van Unit, Acceptatie en Integratie Testing
alsook Test Driven Development
Minstens een Bachelor en/of Master op zak hebt in een IT-gerelateerde opleiding
.

AANBOD

Als .NET Fullstack Developer
bij Axxes geniet je niet enkel van een gevarieerde en uitdagende rol maar er wordt ook enorm ingezet op feel good & werknemerstevredenheid
. Niet voor niets dat we de titel van Best Workplace 2025 gewonnen
hebben! Denk aan een fijne sfeer, team-weekends, jaarlijkse Axxes ski-reis, maandelijkse drinks, ...

Deze feelgood gecombineerd met onze cultuur van kennisdeling
maakt dat je steeds kan deelnemen aan workshops en andere initiatieven georganiseerd door jouw collega’s.

Dit alles aangevuld met een competitieve verloning
, een bedrijfswagen (of mogelijkheid tot mobiliteitsbudget!) en een totaalpakket aan extra-legale voordelen! Zaken zoals een FIP-plan
, een uitgebreid opleidingsbudget
, hybride werkbeleid
, netto-onkostenvergoeding, verzekeringen, gsm, -en internetabonnementen, … mogen natuurlijk niet ontbreken.

Heb jij het gevoel dat deze uitdaging voor jou weggelegd is? Aarzel dan niet om te solliciteren en dan ontmoeten we je hopelijk snel op een van onze kantoren in Gent of Antwerpen!

AANBOD PERMANENT

Innovatieve Klantprojecten
: Werk mee aan uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende klanten zoals VRT, TomTom, DPG Media, Accent, Port of Antwerp, Katoen Natie,… waarbij je voortdurend wordt uitgedaagd met de nieuwste technologieën.
Persoonlijke en Professionele Ontwikkeling
: Ervaar groei door individuele coaching van technische experts, die je begeleiden op persoonlijk en professioneel vlak. Aangevuld met een individueel opleidingsbudget dat je kan inzetten voor opleidingen, conferenties in binnen- en buitenland en doorgedreven certificatie.
Cultuur van kennisdeling
: Je kan steeds deelnemen aan workshops en andere initiatieven georganiseerd door jouw collega's. Omgekeerd kan jij zowel binnen jouw team, als met experts uit onze verschillende IT-domeinen, impact maken door jouw kennis te delen en bij te dragen aan de innovatie en groei van Axxes.
Feel Good @ Axxes
: Axxes is één van de Best Workplaces van België, gestuurd door de woorden 'IT is about People'. Op regelmatige basis komen we dan ook graag samen tijdens familie-events, maandelijkse drinks, hackathons, sportinitiatieven, employee initiatives (fiets- en wandelclub, quiz-nights, karting,…). Kortom, voor ieder wat wils!
Flexibel werken:
Profiteer van een flexibel werkregime met thuiswerkdagen, afgestemd op de behoeften van jou en de klant, voor een optimale work-life balans.
Volledig geoptimaliseerd pakket:
We bieden een competitief salaris met keuze tussen een bedrijfswagen of mobiliteitsbudget, aangevuld met een heel scala aan extralegale voordelen.

AANBOD FREELANCERS

Start je graag als Freelancer via Axxes op een project? Dan nodigen we jou graag uit voor een gesprek. Tijdens deze persoonlijke kennismaking zoomen we in op jouw ervaring en wensen en maak je kennis met onze persoonlijke en pragmatische approach
.
Op basis hiervan maken we een selectie in onze projecten die jou op het lijf geschreven zijn. Bij onze meer dan 140 rechtstreekse klanten in Vlaanderen & Brussel
is er zeker een plekje voor jou.
Ook tijdens jouw project zorgen we ervoor dat je niets tekort komt: meerdere aanspreekpunten
waar je terechtkan bij vragen.
Je geeft zelf aan hoe vaak en op welke manier je opvolging
wenst, wij zorgen meermaals per jaar voor knowledge sharing
én informele feel good momenten
en tot slot betalen we correct en stipt
.

Senior Cloud Architect

Contract One-year B2B contract

Location Brussels (EU fully remote or 50% onsite in Brussels)

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Architect to join the Cloud System Team.
The Cloud System Team defines, engineers and continuously evolves the organisation's cloud capabilities, enabling secure, scalable and resilient cloud adoption across corporate, business-critical and highly critical operational workloads.
The cloud environment is primarily based on Microsoft Azure and follows a landing zone model aligned with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework. It uses Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps, policy-driven governance and self-service consumption to provide standardized cloud capabilities to application teams.
The Senior Cloud Architect contributes to the design and evolution of cloud architectures, foundations and platform capabilities. The role supports cloud adoption, workload modernization and datacenter-to-cloud migration initiatives and provides architecture studies, solution designs and technical guidance. Working with Cloud Platform Engineering, Security, Cloud Run, Network, Enterprise Architecture and application teams, the architect helps ensure solutions are secure, resilient, supportable and aligned with approved architectural direction, including future multi-cloud capabilities.
Key Tasks and Responsibilities

The scope includes, but is not limited to:
Cloud Architecture and Solution Design
Contribute to the design and evolution of the Azure cloud platform, landing zones, and workload architectures.
Produce architecture studies, HLDs, technical assessments, reference patterns and option analyses for complex cloud initiatives.
Support workload onboarding, critical workload architecture, application modernization and datacenter-to-cloud migration initiatives.

Cloud Governance, Security and Standards
Contribute to cloud architecture principles, standards, governance requirements and policies.
Define architecture guidance for Zero Trust, identity, privileged access, network isolation, Private Link and Azure-native security capabilities.
Ensure alignment between business, security, compliance, operational and platform requirements.

Cloud Networking Architecture
Define architecture patterns for Virtual WAN, hub-and-spoke, ExpressRoute, VPN, routing, segmentation and hybrid connectivity.
Guide multi-region networking, Private Link, traffic inspection and third-party networking or SD-WAN integration.
Collaborate with Network and Platform Engineering teams to ensure designs are secure, implementable and operationally supportable.

Resilience and Operational Architecture
Define architecture patterns for highly available, zone-redundant, multi-region and highly critical workloads.
Define backup, disaster recovery, recoverability and operational continuity approaches aligned with availability, RTO and RPO requirements.
Ensure solutions are observable, supportable, maintainable and operationally viable in collaboration with Cloud Run and application teams.

Application and Platform Engineering Enablement
Guide application teams and projects on Azure service selection, architecture trade-offs, migration approaches and modernization options.
Work with Cloud Platform Engineers to translate approved architecture into reusable platform services and self-service capabilities.
Review designs, identify constraints and risks, and promote reuse, standardization and automation.

Technology Strategy and Innovation
Conduct technology evaluations, proofs of concept and architecture assessments for new Azure and cloud capabilities.
Contribute to cloud roadmaps, datacenter exit and cloud transformation initiatives and future multi-cloud scenarios.
Assess strategic options, technical debt, simplification opportunities and long-term platform evolution.

Collaboration, Documentation and Knowledge Sharing
Collaborate with Cloud Platform Engineering, Cloud Run, Security, Network, Enterprise Architecture and application teams.
Facilitate architecture reviews, design workshops and technical decision-making within the established design authority.
Maintain HLDs, reference architectures, architecture decisions, design guidance and knowledge-sharing material.

Job Requirements

Technical Competencies and Experience
Proven expertise in designing and governing enterprise-scale cloud architectures and cloud operating models.
Extensive expertise in Microsoft Azure architecture, cloud adoption and landing zone design aligned with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.
Proven expertise producing HLDs, architecture studies, assessments, reference patterns and technical recommendations for complex cloud initiatives.
Proven architecture expertise in datacenter-to-cloud migrations, workload discovery and assessment, migration strategy, application modernization and transition planning.
Proven expertise designing architectures for business-critical and highly critical operational workloads with demanding security, availability, resilience and continuity requirements.
Strong expertise in cloud governance, policy-as-code, cloud security architecture, Zero Trust, Microsoft Entra ID and privileged access design.
Strong expertise in Azure networking architecture, including Virtual WAN, hub-and-spoke, ExpressRoute, VPN, routing, segmentation, hybrid connectivity, Private Link and traffic inspection.
Proven expertise designing highly available, zone-redundant, multi-region, backup and disaster-recovery architectures, including RTO and RPO considerations.
Strong understanding of Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, platform engineering, Azure DevOps and DevSecOps operating models.
Proven ability to assess technology and migration options, architecture trade-offs, implementation constraints, operational impacts and long-term platform evolution.
Excellent architecture documentation, workshop facilitation, stakeholder engagement and technical communication capabilities.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with Security, Platform Engineering, Network, Operations, Enterprise Architecture and application stakeholders.
Proven knowledge of AWS architecture and multi-cloud design principles is considered an advantage.

Level of Education

new_jobs.title: Global OT Application Engineer
new_jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Engineer implements, integrates, tests, deploys and supports industrial applications across manufacturing sites. The role configures and implements global use cases and applications.

The Application Engineer is the technical bridge between plants, application owners, developers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, software vendors and system integrators. The role covers both purchased or configured applications and internally built solutions; it is neither limited to software development nor to coordination.

Assigned scope:

Global OT applications across manufacturing sites, including MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT and CMMS domains.
Purchased, configured and internally developed applications and their interfaces to plant and business systems.

Primary emphasis:

Applications are deployed safely, consistently and with clear acceptance evidence.
Plant systems exchange accurate and reliable data through governed interfaces.
Sites receive effective onboarding, technical support and operational handover.
Incidents and recurring technical problems are resolved at the appropriate support level.
Global templates and standards are applied without losing control of necessary local adaptations.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Implementation and Integration:

Configure and implement applications, templates and technical components in accordance with the approved solution design.
Gather requirements to integrate applications with PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES/MOM, IIoT, historians and business systems such as ERP, LIMS or QMS.
Configure and troubleshoot industrial data exchange using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ensure that global libraries, naming conventions, templates, interfaces and deployment standards are followed.
Document any approved local deviation from the global template, including its justification and approval, in the application documentation.
Review technical and functional deliveries from developers, vendors and system integrators and challenge gaps in quality, maintainability or operability.

Testing and Validation:

Translate approved requirements and designs into a complete and traceable technical test scope.
Prepare and execute functional, integration and regression tests and support FAT, SAT and user acceptance testing.
Diagnose bugs, coordinate correction and test cycles, and maintain clear test evidence and release documentation.
Verify connectivity, data integrity, performance, resilience, security controls and operational readiness.
Confirm that acceptance criteria are met before recommending release or production deployment.

Deployment and Site Onboarding:

Lead the technical work required to take an application from a controlled release into stable plant operation.
Assess site readiness, infrastructure, signals, interfaces, data availability and local dependencies.
Coordinate technical activities with plant stakeholders, local OT teams, vendors and system integrators.
Execute or supervise installation, configuration, commissioning and cut-over activities.
Provide hypercare, technical training, documentation and a clear handover to support and site teams.

Operations and Support:

Provide ITIL-based L2/L3 application support: advanced troubleshooting, functional bug-fixing and technical incident escalation across sites (ITIL support levels, not Purdue Model network layers).
Perform problem management: conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for recurring application errors.
Manage technical change requests: oversee software modifications from assessment through testing, release and production deployment.
Monitor application health: track application performance, data interfaces (APIs) and support trends to recommend continuous improvements.
Maintain knowledge databases: manage technical documentation, application runbooks, release notes and Known-Error Databases (KEDB).

Plant and Technical Team Interface:

Act as the practical interface between plant operations and the teams that design, build and supply the applications.
Translate plant constraints and operational issues into actionable technical requirements and bugs.
Explain technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions to plant and business stakeholders.
Coordinate effectively with the Application Owner on priorities, scope, standards and acceptance.
Work with developers on build activities and with delivery leads or Scrum Masters on planning and execution.
Challenge vendors and system integrators on technical quality, delivery evidence and issue resolution, escalating commercial or roadmap matters to the Application Owner.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Strong knowledge of at least one relevant application domain: MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or CMMS, and of interfaces to PLC, SCADA and DCS systems.
Practical integration knowledge using OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ability to read, adapt or create components using Python, C#, Java or JavaScript when needed.
Working knowledge of versioning, release, incident, problem and change-management practices.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 principles, OT cybersecurity and regulated validation requirements where applicable.

Behavioral Competencies:

Plant-oriented, pragmatic and structured, with strong ownership of technical issues.
Constructive challenge of delivery evidence from developers, vendors and system integrators.
Clear cross-functional communication across plant, specialist and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in automation, electrical, software or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience with industrial applications, automation, MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or comparable manufacturing systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated responsibility across multiple sites or complex industrial programs.

Unirse a Septeo significa formar parte de un proyecto colectivo internacional, impulsar la transformación del grupo en un entorno de rápida evolución y convertir la IA en un motor tangible de creación de valor, tanto en el presente como en el futuro.

Descripción del empleo

How You’ll Have Impact

Build the Platform Behind the Platform: Design and evolve the cloud infrastructure that powers our multi-tenant SaaS ecosystem.
Enable Engineering Velocity: Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.
Drive Reliability & Observability: Ensure high availability, performance, and real-time visibility across distributed systems.
Architect for Scale: Design infrastructure that supports growth, AI workloads, and distributed services.
Champion Infrastructure as Code: Everything reproducible, versioned, and automated.
Embed Security by Design: Implement DevSecOps best practices across the delivery lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure.
Manage and optimize containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or equivalent).
Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.
Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (ELK stack, Grafana dashboards and alerting, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools).
Operate, monitor, and tune Microsoft SQL Server databases (performance, backups, high availability).
Optimize system performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate closely with backend engineers (Java / Kotlin, C#, Node.js) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.
Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
Leverage AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Codex, automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.
Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.

You don’t just maintain infrastructure — you engineer the reliability of the business.

Cloud Building Blocks: AWS & Azure

We Run Workloads On Both AWS And Azure. We Are Looking For Solid Hands-on Experience With IaaS And Core Managed Cloud Services On At Least One Of Them — Knowing The Equivalent On The Other Cloud Is a Strong Plus. These Are The Building Blocks You’ll Work With

Virtual machines & autoscaling — Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets | AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups
Virtual networking — Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints | AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink
L7 load balancing + WAF — Azure: Application Gateway + WAF | AWS: Application Load Balancer + AWS WAF
Web app / API hosting — Azure: App Service | AWS: Elastic Beanstalk / App Runner
Managed Kubernetes — Azure: AKS | AWS: EKS
Message queues — Azure: Azure Storage — Queues | AWS: Amazon SQS
Object storage — Azure: Azure Storage — Blobs | AWS: Amazon S3
In-memory cache — Azure: Azure Cache for Redis | AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)
Managed SQL Server — Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance | AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server
Workload identity (secretless auth) — Azure: Managed Identity + DefaultAzureCredential | AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) + SDK default credential chain
Secrets & keys — Azure: Key Vault | AWS: AWS Secrets Manager / KMS
Transactional email — Azure: Azure Communication Services (Email) | AWS: Amazon SES
Per-environment configuration — Azure: App Settings | AWS: Systems Manager Parameter Store / AppConfig
Logs, metrics & alerts — Azure: Log Analytics / Azure Monitor | AWS: Amazon CloudWatch
Runtime diagnostics — Azure: Kudu / App Service diagnostics | AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights / SSM Session Manager

Requisitos

5+ years of experience in DevOps / Cloud Engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with AWS or Azure — experience with both is a strong plus.
Deep understanding of containerization and distributed systems, with production experience in Kubernetes (required).
Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or similar).
Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server (administration, performance tuning, backup/restore, high availability).
Experience with Redis in production (caching, session storage, pub/sub).
Strong knowledge of networking, security, and system architecture.
Experience working in high-availability SaaS environments.
Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and incident management, including Grafana dashboards and alerting.
Automation-first mindset.
Experience collaborating with backend engineering teams.
Languages: fluent Spanish and professional English (both required).

We don’t expect you to master every tool listed above, but we do expect solid hands-on experience with at least one technology in each area: cloud provider (AWS / Azure), containers & orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and databases & caching.

Nice-to-Have Superpowers

Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements.
Experience with cost optimization strategies in cloud environments.
Knowledge of GitOps workflows.
Experience in multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure.
Scripting skills (Bash, Python).
French — a huge plus (we can dream!).

We're building a delivery team for a large, multi-phase enterprise Mendix programme and are looking for a Senior Mendix Developer to lead the technical build as a key member of the team.

Role summary
We are looking for a Senior Mendix Developer to act as Technical Lead for a large, multi-phase enterprise Mendix programme, building the most complex processes and integrations and leading a hybrid onsite/offsite team of Mendix, mobile, integration and DevOps engineers.

Key responsibilities
- Lead the day-to-day technical build and act as the technical point of contact for the development, mobile, integration and DevOps team.
- Take over an existing Mendix application built by another team and extend it rather than rebuild it.
- Build the most complex processes, including multi-step approval workflows with send-back, SLA timers and escalation, calculation and rules engines, and financial postings.
- Guide the build of shared components: request handling, configurable rules, notifications, document generation, schedulers, reports and KPI dashboards.
- Guide the Mendix native mobile build (iOS and Android), including offline drafts, secure storage, biometric login, push notifications and in-app payments.
- Lead the Mendix side of all integrations with the Integration Developer: REST/SOAP contracts, error handling, retries, idempotency, exception queues and reconciliation.
- Integrate with document management, digital identity and e-signature, payment gateway, finance/ERP, banking, CRM and government systems through the ESB.
- Work with the DevOps Engineer on CI/CD for Mendix web and native mobile builds, environment promotion and releases in waves.

Key requirements
- Mendix Advanced certification (state certificate ID).

- API authentication (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, API keys, certificates) and integration through an ESB / middleware layer.
- Reliable integration patterns: error handling, retries, idempotency, callbacks / webhooks, batch / file exchange, logging and reconciliation.
- Mendix native mobile (iOS and Android): offline-first design, device features and mobile security (working knowledge or better).
